articles.title: The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces
articles.abstract: A four-stage LLM pipeline gives up as much as 40.5 accuracy points at its own interfaces (gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19; the largest tax in the primary family). We hold model, problem, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, vary only whether each stage can still see the original problem, and call the accuracy difference the decomposition tax. Across 21 open-weight models from nine organisations, on GSM-Hard and MATH-500 at n = 200 paired items per cell, 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction and 54 survive Holm. On GSM-Hard, a placebo recovers nothing: it carries at least 60% of the extra tokens and at most one word of the problem. Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. Rewriting one stage's instruction moves gemma-3-12B's tax from 4.5 to 36.5 points, and adding "every relationship stated between them" to a stage that lists the numerical quantities lowers the tax on 9 of 9 models on MATH-500. Re-grounding, which shows a stage the original problem again, belongs after the loss. With one lossy interface, re-grounding the stage after it beats re-grounding the stage before it on 7 of 7 models on both benchmarks; on MATH-500 the earlier repair is worse than none on 7 of 7. Newer models still pay: gemma-4-12B gives up 37.0 points, and the repair holds on all three of the newest models we test. A sealed held-out test refuted a stronger rule we registered, which predicted the paying stage from the interface and receiver types, so we locate the tax by measuring one stage at a time. The prescription has two parts: re-ground the stage after the lossy interface, and if a stage must list the quantities, tell it to keep the relationships.
articles.titleCn: 分解税：LLM管道在其接口处损失高达40个准确度点
articles.abstractCn: 一个四阶段的大语言模型流水线在其接口处最多会损失40.5个准确率点（在MATH-500上使用gemma-3-12B，Holm校正p = 1.66e-19；这是主要家族中最大的税额）。我们保持模型、问题、阶段、阶段提示和完成预算不变，仅改变每个阶段是否还能看到原始问题，并将准确率差异称为分解税。在来自九个组织的21个开放权重模型中，在GSM-Hard和MATH-500上，每个单元格n = 200对项目，118个主要家族测试中有70个通过Benjamini-Hochberg校正，54个通过Holm校正。在GSM-Hard上，安慰剂一无所获：它至少包含60%的额外标记，最多包含问题中的一个词。构建者逐阶段设计流水线，而账单则出现在阶段之间的接口处。重写一个阶段的指令将gemma-3-12B的税额从4.5点变为36.5点，向一个列出数值量的阶段添加“它们之间所陈述的每一种关系”则降低了MATH-500上9个模型中的税额。重新校准，即向阶段再次展示原始问题，应在损失之后进行。对于单个有损接口，在两个基准测试上，对它之后的阶段进行重新校准比对其之前的阶段进行重新校准在7个模型上都更优；在MATH-500上，较早的修复比不修复在7个模型上都更差。较新的模型仍然会付出代价：gemma-4-12B损失了37.0点，并且这种修复在我们测试的所有三个最新模型上都有效。一个密封的保留测试反驳了我们注册的一个更强的规则，该规则根据接口和接收器类型预测会付出代价的阶段，因此我们通过逐个测量一个阶段来定位税额。处方有两个部分：重新校准有损接口之后的阶段，并且如果某个阶段必须列出数量，则告诉它保留关系。

articles.title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
articles.abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.
articles.titleCn: USAI-Quant：建筑环境中视觉语言模型的量化推理基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）已成为城市和空间人工智能领域的一种强大范式。然而，当前最先进的大型VLMs在处理遥感影像的定量推理方面仍面临挑战。现有的基准和算法主要基于定性的视觉问答（VQA），对VLMs在建成环境指标方面的定量推理能力提供了有限的洞察。为填补这一空白，我们开发了定量城市和空间人工智能基准（USAI-Quant），这是首个通过遥感影像定量评估VLM在建成环境指标推理能力的基准。USAI-Quant是从美国335个最大城市中精心筛选的，将高分辨率遥感影像与定量建成环境指标进行匹配。随后，我们通过应用针对三个复杂度级别的数十项建成环境指标的VQA，评估了通用型和遥感型VLMs（RS-VLMs）。我们的结果表明，当前最先进的模型在数值推理任务上始终表现不足。我们进一步对模型、问题类型和地理位置进行了深入分析，揭示了性能差异和特定任务的挑战。

articles.title: OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Discussion Trajectories
articles.abstract: Multidisciplinary tumor boards integrate multimodal clinical observations and longitudinal patient histories through specialist discussions, yet benchmarks rarely capture these real-world trajectories. We introduce OpenTumorBoard, a benchmark with 611 patient cases and 19,157 discussion turns across ten specialist roles, transcribed from 12,534 minutes of publicly available tumor board recordings on YouTube. The benchmark evaluates two settings: SPECIALIST TURN, in which an LLM responds to a clinically significant question posed during a real discussion, and BOARD SIMULATION, in which it generates an entire back-and-forth discussion and reaches a consensus on therapy recommendations, surgical plans, next actions and clinical trial matching. Evaluation of 14 general-purpose frontier and medical LLMs reveals substantial limitations: the best models score 3.43 out of 5 in clinical equivalence to specialist answers and 2.78 out of 5 in alignment with recorded board conclusions. Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning improve performance on a held-out test set, suggesting that real-world discussion trajectories can support model adaptation. Three M.D. experts review a subset of the benchmark, finding high information coverage and factuality of patient cases and strong fidelity of extracted consensus conclusions. We will release OpenTumorBoard and its automated curation pipeline to support the development and evaluation of LLMs for multidisciplinary, personalized cancer decision-making.
articles.titleCn: OpenTumorBoard：多学科肿瘤讨论轨迹的真实世界基准
articles.abstractCn: 多学科肿瘤委员会通过专家讨论整合了多模式临床观察和纵向患者病史，但基准测试很少捕捉这些现实轨迹。我们介绍了OpenTumorBoard，这是一个包含611个病例和跨越十个专家角色的19,157个讨论回合的基准测试，这些讨论回合是从YouTube上公开可用的12,534分钟的肿瘤委员会录音中转录而来的。该基准测试评估了两种设置：专家回合（SPECIALIST TURN），其中大型语言模型（LLM）回应在真实讨论中提出的临床相关问题，以及委员会模拟（BOARD SIMULATION），其中它生成整个来回讨论并就治疗建议、手术计划、下一步行动和临床试验匹配达成共识。对14个通用前沿和医学LLM的评估揭示了重大局限性：最佳模型的临床等效性得分仅为5分中的3.43分，与记录的委员会结论的一致性得分为5分中的2.78分。监督微调和强化学习提高了在保留测试集上的性能，表明现实世界的讨论轨迹可以支持模型适应。三位医学专家审查了基准测试的一个子集，发现病例的信息覆盖率和事实性都很高，提取的共识结论的保真度也很强。我们将发布OpenTumorBoard及其自动化管理流程，以支持多学科个性化癌症决策的LLM的开发和评估。

articles.title: Overwhelmed by Choice: Studying LLM Decision Making at Scale
articles.abstract: Multiple-choice and candidate-selection evaluations are widely used to assess LLM reasoning and decision-making, yet most benchmarks contain relatively small candidate sets. It remains unclear whether conclusions drawn from these settings remain valid as the candidate space scales. We systematically evaluate LLMs as the number of competing candidates increases and find substantial accuracy degradation across tasks, prompting strategies, and model scales. Controlled analyses show that standard long-context retrieval explanations cannot fully account for this degradation. Instead, we identify two systematic failure patterns. First, gold-margin collapse: the score gap between the correct answer and the strongest distractor progressively shrinks, driven primarily by weakening confidence in the correct answer. Second, earlier candidate preferences become increasingly difficult to overturn, with later candidates exerting progressively weaker influence on the final prediction. Motivated by these findings, we evaluate hierarchical partitioning and permutation-based inference, which improve accuracy by roughly 20 percentage points at $N=160$ on both HotpotQA and MIMIC. Overall, our results identify candidate-set scale as an important evaluation-protocol variable and show that strong small-option performance does not necessarily imply robust large-scale candidate comparison.
articles.comment: Accepted at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop. 23 pages
articles.titleCn: 被选择淹没：大规模研究大型语言模型的决策过程
articles.abstractCn: 多项选择和候选人选择评估被广泛用于评估大语言模型的推理和决策能力，但大多数基准测试中的候选人集相对较小。随着候选人空间的扩展，这些设置得出的结论是否仍然有效尚不清楚。我们系统地评估了随着竞争候选人数量的增加，大语言模型的表现，发现任务、提示策略和模型规模方面都存在显著的准确率下降。控制分析表明，标准的上下文检索解释不能完全解释这种下降。相反，我们确定了两种系统性的失败模式。首先，黄金边缘坍塌：正确答案和最强干扰项之间的分数差距逐渐缩小，主要由对正确答案的信心减弱驱动。其次，早期的候选人偏好越来越难以改变，后期候选人对最终预测的影响越来越弱。受这些发现的启发，我们评估了分层划分和基于排列的推理，这两种方法在HotpotQA和MIMIC上都将准确率提高了约20个百分点（当N=160时）。总的来说，我们的结果表明候选人集规模是一个重要的评估协议变量，并且强大的小选项表现并不一定意味着在大规模候选人比较中具有鲁棒性。

articles.title: Mind the Spike: Mechanisms and Brittleness of Visual Massive Activations in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) inherit massive activations from their text-only bases: spikes where a few fixed hidden channels receive values thousands of times above the typical magnitude. The text spike systematically appears in early layers at a fixed initial position, independently of input content. Visual spikes vary across images, but whether their formation follows a consistent pattern across LVLMs and how they respond to image perturbations remain open questions. We find that some LVLMs do not form visual spikes, while others spike at different rates, typically in deeper layers. We identify the trigger direction from model weights and an interpretable location rule: before the language model decoder runs, eventual spike tokens are largely restricted to those sharing least with the rest of the image. Crucially, visual spikes are strikingly brittle. Common corruptions frequently create and relocate spikes, and less often remove them, raising overall incidence. Our trigger-guided spike attack deliberately creates or removes spikes under a small $\ell_\infty$ budget, with 1/255 enough in nine of the ten models that spike. Finally, our preventive intervention removes only the trigger component before spikes erupt, eliminating or substantially reducing spikes on clean and perturbed images while leaving the other image tokens nearly unchanged. Our study spans 25 adapter-based LVLMs built on 18 released text-only bases from 10 families, ranging from 2B to 72B parameters.
articles.titleCn: 注意峰值：大型视觉语言模型中视觉大规模激活的机制和脆弱性
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）从其纯文本基础继承了大量激活：少数固定隐藏通道接收到的值远超典型幅度的尖峰。这种文本尖峰系统性地出现在早期层的一个固定初始位置，与输入内容无关。视觉尖峰在不同图像中有所变化，但其形成是否遵循LVLMs之间的一致模式，以及它们如何响应图像扰动，仍是未解之谜。我们发现，某些LVLMs不形成视觉尖峰，而另一些则在不同的速率下尖峰，通常出现在较深层。我们从模型权重和可解释的位置规则中识别出触发方向：在语言模型解码器运行之前，最终的尖峰标记主要局限于与图像其他部分共享最少的那些。关键在于，视觉尖峰非常脆弱。常见的损坏经常创建和重新定位尖峰，偶尔移除它们，从而提高了整体发生率。我们的触发引导尖峰攻击在小的$\ell_\infty$预算内故意创建或移除尖峰，在十个模型中的九个（尖峰的模型）中，1/255就足够了。最后，我们的预防干预在尖峰爆发前仅移除触发组件，从而消除或大幅减少干净和扰动图像上的尖峰，同时几乎未改变其他图像标记。我们的研究涵盖了25个基于18个已发布的纯文本基础（来自10个家族，参数范围从2B到72B）构建的适配器式LVLMs。

articles.title: Decision-Sufficient State Representations: Measuring and Reducing Write-Time Regret
articles.abstract: Long tasks produce more history than an LLM agent can hold in its context, and more than it uses reliably even when the history fits. A growing line of work therefore has agents carry a short written state instead: at every step a writer rewrites the state, and a reader acts from the state alone. Steps stay cheap, but anything the writer drops is lost before later decisions reveal that they need it. We quantify this loss and ask whether training can reduce it. Comparing the written state with the best state of the same size written in hindsight, we split the reader's loss into a budget loss, which any state of that size must incur, and a write-time regret, which comes from the writer's choices. In TextWorld cooking games where we control how long a fact must be carried before it is needed, a 128-token state holding the facts wins nearly every game, while prompted language-model writers win at most 17%. Almost all of the loss is write-time regret, and it grows with the delay. We then train the writer from the reader's own loss. DSSR (decision-sufficient state representations) scores candidate states by how well the reader acts after the writer carries them forward, and teaches the writer to prefer the better ones. This forward-rolled score predicts game outcomes ($ρ= 0.48$), whereas scoring a candidate as a fixed context, as hindsight methods usually do, does not ($ρ\leq 0.07$). On a pre-registered test split opened once, training adds +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] points of success when facts are needed soon, bringing a plain summary writer to the level of belief- and slot-based memory prompts. The gain shrinks as the delay grows and is significant only at the shortest delay. We trace this limit to credit assignment: keeping a fact now pays off only if every later rewrite keeps it too, which a per-step score cannot see.

articles.titleCn: 决策充分状态表示：测量与减少写入时后悔
articles.abstractCn: 长任务产生的历史记录比大型语言模型代理在其上下文中能持有的要多，即使历史记录符合其容量，它也使用得不够可靠。因此，越来越多的工作让代理携带一个简短的文字状态：在每个步骤中，作者重写状态，而读者仅根据状态行动。步骤保持廉价，但作者丢弃的任何内容在后续决策揭示需要它之前就会丢失。我们量化这种损失，并询问训练是否能减少它。将写入状态与相同大小的、事后写下的最佳状态进行比较，我们将读者的损失分为预算损失，即任何该大小的状态都必须承担的损失，以及写入时后悔，这是来自作者选择的损失。在TextWorld烹饪游戏中，我们控制事实必须携带多长时间才能被需要，一个持有事实的128个token状态赢得几乎所有游戏，而提示语言模型作者最多赢得17%。几乎所有的损失都是写入时后悔，并且随着延迟的增长而增长。然后我们从读者的自身损失中训练作者。DSSR（决策充分状态表示）通过读者在作者携带它们之后行动的好坏来评分候选状态，并教会作者更喜欢更好的状态。这个向前滚动的评分预测游戏结果（ρ=0.48），而像事后方法通常那样将候选状态评分为一个固定上下文则不会（ρ≤0.07）。在一个预先注册的测试分割中一次性打开，当事实很快需要时，训练增加了+7.0 [+1.9, +12.2]点的成功，使一个简单的摘要作者达到了基于信念和槽位的记忆提示的水平。随着延迟的增长，收益会缩小，并且仅在最短的延迟时才显著。我们将这一极限归因于信用分配：现在保留一个事实只有在每个后续重写也保留它时才会得到回报，而每步评分无法看到这一点。

articles.title: Re-derivability Decides What a Staged Agent Pipeline Recovers After an Upstream Fault
articles.abstract: One variable sets what an upstream fault costs a staged pipeline of language-model agents: re-derivability, how much of what a stage needs it can rebuild from the original problem. Grounding an inspector agent in that problem is worth +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] to +0.358 over a blind one on four open-weight backbones served with thinking disabled, and on the two Qwen backbones the blind inspector changes no item at all. That head-to-head is exploratory. One deterministic fault enters the first stage, and we re-expose the original problem to $k = 0,\dots,3$ of the downstream stages with agents, items, fault and topology held fixed, on 120 gsm_hard items per arm at temperature zero. Accuracy under fault rises on four of four backbones, from +0.233 to +0.392, the largest Holm-adjusted $p$ being $2.1\times10^{-6}$. A registered kill test rules out tokens. Blanking every word holds the word slots fixed, and retention tracks the visible fraction on four of four, climbing from 0.221 to 0.692 on the primary. Those two families are confirmatory and everything else here is exploratory. The interaction excludes zero on two of four backbones under the registered pipeline, four of four under a three-stage pipeline, and three of four under full message history, the primary at +0.317. On Llama-3.1-8B the fault carries no detectable cost at any dose, so the other three carry every claim about what a fault costs. Re-derivability also sets what the architecture costs, and no decomposition we measured reliably beats one direct call. With no fault injected the registered pipeline loses to that call by -0.267, -0.125 and -0.317, and on Phi-4 reads +0.058 at $p = 0.118$, which the test fails to separate from zero. The repair that works is cheap and front-loaded: the first re-grounded stage buys +0.394 of matched retention for +59.8 tokens per item on Qwen3-14B, and the stages after it buy nothing.

articles.titleCn: 重新可推导性决定了在发生上游故障后，分阶段代理管道能恢复什么
articles.abstractCn: 一个变量决定了上游故障对一个语言模型代理分阶段管道的成本：可重新推导性，即一个阶段需要什么，它能从原始问题中重建多少。将一个检查代理基于该问题进行定位，比在四个禁用思考功能的开放权重主干上的盲目检查代理的价值高出 +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] 到 +0.358，而在两个Qwen主干上，盲目检查代理没有任何项目更改。这种一对一比较是探索性的。一个确定性故障进入第一阶段，我们将原始问题重新暴露给下游阶段的 $k = 0,\dots,3$ 个代理，保持代理、项目、故障和拓扑结构不变，在每条臂上使用120个gsm_hard项目，温度为零。在故障下的准确性在四个主干上都有所提高，从 +0.233 提高到 +0.392，最大的Holm调整 $p$ 值为 $2.1\times10^{-6}$。一个注册的杀死测试排除了标记。清空每个单词会保持单词槽固定，保留跟踪四个主干上的可见部分，在主要主干上从 0.221 上升到 0.692。这两个系列是确认性的，而这里的其他一切都是探索性的。交互在四个主干中的两个上注册管道为0，在三个阶段管道上有四个主干，在完整消息历史中有三个主干，主要主干为 +0.317。在Llama-3.1-8B上，任何剂量下的故障都没有可检测的成本，因此其他三个都承载了关于故障成本的所有主张。可重新推导性还决定了架构的成本，我们没有测量的任何分解可靠地超过了直接调用。没有注入故障时，注册管道在 -0.267、-0.125 和 -0.317 上输给了该调用，在Phi-4上读取 +0.058，$p = 0.118$，该测试未能将其与零区分开来。有效的修复是廉价且前置的：第一个重新定位的阶段为每个项目花费 59.8 个标记，为Qwen3-14B提供了 +0.394 的匹配保留，而它之后的阶段什么也没买。

articles.title: Understanding and Exploiting Anisotropy in Post-Training
articles.abstract: LLM post-training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT), a mode-covering forward-KL objective, with reinforcement learning (RL), a mode-seeking reverse-KL objective. Frequency-weighted likelihood training leaves a well-known signature: \emph{anisotropy}, in which a few residual channels carry disproportionately large activations. Anisotropy is widely documented and usually treated as a defect, yet its function and its interaction with post-training remain unclear. We first analyze it. A label-free outlier rule isolates about 5\% of residual channels that are essential for language modeling: removing them raises perplexity from 10 to over $10^6$, versus 35 for count-matched random channels. Yet they barely distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning. SFT reshapes them, whereas RL leaves them largely intact and adapts the complementary channels. These channels therefore form the model's \emph{coherence substrate}, and reasoning adaptation happens elsewhere. We then exploit this. \textsc{SphereGate} learns one bounded gain per residual channel on a frozen backbone. Its activation-weighted gradients provably limit movement of high-energy coherence channels and leave the remaining channels free. With 0.1M trainable parameters, \textsc{SphereGate} outperforms parameter-efficient baselines by 2.0--7.3 points on MATH-500 across Qwen2.5 (0.5B--7B) and Llama-3-8B, is comparable or exceeds full-model GRPO. Anisotropy is not a defect but a division of labor that post-training can exploit.
articles.titleCn: 理解并利用训练后的各向异性
articles.abstractCn: LLM的后续训练结合了监督微调（SFT），这是一种覆盖模式的正向KL目标，以及强化学习（RL），这是一种寻求模式的反向KL目标。频率加权似然训练留下了一个众所周知的特征：**各向异性**，其中少数残差通道承载了不成比例的大激活。各向异性被广泛记录，通常被视为缺陷，但其功能和它与后续训练的相互作用尚不清楚。我们首先对其进行了分析。无标签的异常值规则隔离了约5%对语言建模至关重要的残差通道：移除它们会使困惑度从10提高到超过10^6，而匹配计数的随机通道则提高了35。然而它们几乎无法区分正确的推理与错误的推理。SFT重塑了它们，而RL则基本保持它们不变，并适应了互补的通道。因此，这些通道形成了模型的**一致性基础**，推理适应发生在其他地方。然后我们利用了这一点。**SphereGate**在冻结的主干上为每个残差通道学习一个有界的增益。其激活加权梯度可证明限制高能一致性通道的运动，并使剩余通道保持自由。拥有0.1M可训练参数，**SphereGate**在MATH-500上，针对Qwen2.5（0.5B--7B）和Llama-3-8B，比参数高效的基线提高了2.0--7.3分，性能相当于或超过完整模型的GRPO。各向异性不是缺陷，而是一种分工，后续训练可以加以利用。

articles.title: CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion
articles.abstract: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.
articles.titleCn: 克莱尔：基于模式的双工流程在医疗行政表单填写中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 医疗行政人员将结构化信息从电子健康记录、转诊系统、理赔系统、服务提供者排班表和工作队列中转移至动态表单。我们开发并评估了CLAIRE（临床语言和代理智能推理与录入），这是一种混合工作流，将字段状态发现、源到字段的映射、确定性验证、有限纠正、升级和审计跟踪分离。我们测试了五种合成医疗行政模式、1,000条源记录、四种界面变体、两种数据质量套件和六种比较器，生成了24,000个基准案例。一个独立的严格输出审计评估了Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B的直接映射，而基于跟踪的操作模拟覆盖了6,000个案例。在评估的合成基准条件下，完整的CLAIRE实现了1.000案例成功率、字段准确率、必填字段完成率和依赖完成率；移除验证将压力套件成功率降至0.500。在模拟中，100.0%的清洁和验证压力案例达到了可由人员审查的草稿，而升级挑战案例仅为68.6%，不支持的情况被阻止。基于场景的节省时间为每个案例149.7-165.5秒，未观察到人员时间。这些发现支持基于模式验证优先的医疗行政自动化，其中语言模型组件辅助映射但不会授权不支持或后果性操作。

articles.title: On the Behavioral Traits of LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Users increasingly describe different AI agents as distinct colleagues to work with. AI personality research aims to quantify such impressions by attributing human-like "traits" to agents. However, existing measures fall short: models' self-reports (S-data) diverge from their actual behavior, while informant ratings from LLM judges (I-data) are costly to scale and cover few everyday scenarios. In this paper, we propose A-B-D to infer traits bottom-up from behavioral data (B-data), namely how agents act on their environment and communicate with users, as recorded in existing trajectories. From 345,667 real-world trajectories spanning 80 models, 12 tasks, and 50 harnesses, we extract 318 candidate features that capture both the actions an agent takes at each step (functional) and the language accompanying them (linguistic). We retain only features that show instance-level stability, cross-task consistency, and model discriminability. Factor analysis of the remaining 79 features uncovers six stable, model-attributable factors, two functional and four linguistic. For example, Kimi-K3 exhibits the most planfulness, whereas GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 are the least energetic. Moreover, we quantify the "knowledge-action gap" in the wild: these factors correlate only weakly with self-reported Big Five scores, even for conceptually matched pairs such as extroversion and energetic (r = 0.07, p = 0.58). Our work offers a new lens for understanding AI personality, with implications for users, developers, and researchers from both computer science and social science.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型智能体的行为特征
articles.abstractCn: 用户越来越倾向于将不同的AI代理描述为可以共事的同事。AI人格研究旨在通过为代理赋予类似人类的“特质”来量化这种印象。然而，现有度量方法存在不足：模型的自我报告（S数据）与其实际行为存在偏差，而来自大型语言模型评判员的信源评分（I数据）则难以扩展且覆盖的日常场景有限。在本文中，我们提出从行为数据（B数据）自下而上推断特质的方法，即代理在其环境中行动以及与用户沟通的方式，这些信息记录在现有的轨迹中。从涵盖80个模型、12项任务和50个应用的345,667个真实世界轨迹中，我们提取了318个候选特征，这些特征既能捕捉代理每一步采取的行动（功能性），也能捕捉伴随这些行动的语言（语言性）。我们仅保留那些表现出实例级稳定性、跨任务一致性和模型可区分性的特征。对剩余的79个特征进行因子分析，揭示了六个稳定且可归因于模型的因子，其中两个功能性，四个语言性。例如，Kimi-K3表现出最高的计划性，而GPT-5.5和GPT-5.6则表现出最低的活力。此外，我们量化了自然场景中的“知识-行动差距”：这些因子与自我报告的五大性格分数的相关性较弱，即使是概念上匹配的特质对（如外向性和活力）的相关性也仅为r = 0.07，p = 0.58。我们的工作为理解AI人格提供了一个新视角，对计算机科学和社会科学领域的用户、开发者和研究人员都具有启示意义。

articles.title: C-HAT-Bench: Benchmarking Chinese AI-Text Detection Beyond Fully Generated Text
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly participate in writing by modifying or extending human drafts, causing machine involvement to vary in both form and extent. Yet most Machine-Generated Text (MGT) detectors are evaluated only on fully human-written versus fully AI-generated text. Because human--AI collaboration can weaken or redistribute cues associated with machine generation, strong performance under this binary setting may overstate detector reliability. This mismatch remains underexplored in Chinese: detection cues are shaped by tokenization and language-specific text distributions, yet controlled resources spanning production settings, domains, and generators remain limited. To fill this gap, we present a Chinese Human-AI Collaborative Text Detection Benchmark (C-HAT-Bench), a unified benchmark that links $5,000$ human-written source texts from five domains to more than $240,000$ variants produced using six generative models under Prefix-Conditioned Continuation as a reference setting and three collaborative production modes. We evaluate $21$ detectors through four protocols spanning zero-shot and pretrained supervised document-level detection, boundary localization, and cross-condition generalization. Relative to Prefix-Conditioned Continuation, mean AUROC across document-level detectors is $12.0\%$ lower on the collaborative production modes, with the largest detector-specific relative decrease reaching $44.4\%$. Transfer across collaborative production modes is also asymmetric, indicating that performance in a given production setting is not a reliable predictor of performance in other production settings.
articles.titleCn: C-HAT-Bench：超越全生成文本的中文AI文本检测基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地参与到写作过程中，通过修改或扩展人类草稿，导致机器参与的形态和程度各不相同。然而，大多数机器生成文本（MGT）检测器仅在完全人类写作与完全AI生成的文本上进行评估。由于人机协作可能会削弱或重新分配与机器生成相关的线索，在这种二元设置下的强性能可能会高估检测器的可靠性。这一不匹配在中国尚未得到充分探索：检测线索受限于分词和特定语言的文本分布，但涵盖生产环境、领域和生成器的受控资源仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了中文人机协作文本检测基准（C-HAT-Bench），这是一个统一的基准，将来自五个领域的5,000篇人类写作源文本与在Prefix-Conditioned Continuation作为参考设置和三种协作生产模式下使用六种生成模型产生的超过240,000个变体相链接。我们通过涵盖零样本和预训练的监督文档级检测、边界定位和跨条件泛化的四个协议评估了21个检测器。与Prefix-Conditioned Continuation相比，在协作生产模式下，文档级检测器的平均AUROC降低了12.0%，其中最大的检测器特定相对降幅达到44.4%。跨协作生产模式的迁移也是非对称的，表明在特定生产环境下的性能并不能可靠地预测其他生产环境下的性能。

articles.title: How Far Do Persona Effects Generalize in Language Models?
articles.abstract: Persona prompts ask language models to answer as particular kinds of people. We test whether relationships learned from these effects predict responses to new questions and remain useful across models and prompts. Across 57 attributes, three behavioral domains, and seven pairs of open 7 to 9B checkpoints, persona effects can be predictable without being portable. Separate attribute and task gains improve prediction beyond shared scaling significantly in OLMo-3 and Qwen2.5, with the most robust evidence in OLMo-3. In that model, target refitting significantly outperforms gains borrowed from each of the other six pairs. Across model transfers, borrowed gains with one amplitude underperform shared scaling in most directions; allowing two target parameters removes the significant losses but yields no significant benefit over target shared scaling. After rewording, refitting significantly outperforms reuse with one amplitude in all six tested pairs, while changes of examples or country context often preserve reuse value. In the tested prompt transfers, regularized updates outperform both reuse strategies in median at 64 target questions per attribute. A separate survey comparison finds that selecting the more responsive checkpoint can worsen human fit; responsiveness is confounded with training status, and temperature calibration largely removes this cost but not errors in group ordering. Within the tested gain representation, apparent transfer can come from target calibration; source relationships must add predictive value beyond calibration and regularization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain
articles.comment: 42 pages, 11 figures, 41 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain
articles.titleCn: 人格特质在语言模型中有多大的泛化能力？
articles.abstractCn: 角色提示要求语言模型以特定类型的人的身份回答。我们测试了从这些效应中学习的关系是否能够预测对新问题的回答，并且是否在模型和提示之间保持有用性。在57个属性、三个行为领域和七对开放7到9B检查点中，角色效应可以被预测，但不可移植。在OLMo-3和Qwen2.5中，单独属性和任务增益的改进显著超越了共享缩放，其中OLMo-3的证据最为稳健。在该模型中，目标重新拟合显著优于从其他六个对中借来的增益。在模型迁移中，单振幅的借用增益在大多数方向上表现不如共享缩放；允许两个目标参数消除了显著损失，但并未在目标共享缩放上带来显著优势。在重新措辞后，重新拟合在所有六对测试中显著优于单振幅的复用，而示例或国家背景的变化通常保留了复用价值。在测试的提示迁移中，正则化更新在64个目标问题每个属性的中位数上优于两种复用策略。一个单独的调查比较发现，选择响应性更强的检查点可能会恶化人类匹配度；响应性与训练状态混淆在一起，温度校准基本消除了这种成本，但并未消除组排序中的错误。在测试的增益表示中，明显的迁移可能来自目标校准；源关系必须在校准和正则化之外增加预测价值。代码和数据可在https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain获取。

articles.title: Adaptive Consistency Graph for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model agents can often make reasonable local decisions on short tasks, yet their performance degrades when success requires long sequences of dependent actions and tool calls. During execution, task requirements, historical evidence, and the current execution state may gradually become disconnected, so later decisions can drift from the original objective. We study this problem by introducing the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) for long-horizon execution. ACG incrementally organizes execution evidence and its provenance in a persistent graph, then constructs a temporary requirement-centered view for each decision under a bounded context budget. Rather than replacing the base agent's planner or tool executor, ACG provides a structured and traceable context view for each decision. In the matched evaluation, ACG improves GPT-5.6-luna's average success from 44.5\% with ReAct to 50.2\%, with the largest gain on BrowseComp-Plus (73.5\% versus 62.4\%). We further analyze trajectory structure and inference cost to characterize this improvement.
articles.titleCn: 长时程智能体自适应一致性图
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理通常能在短期任务中做出合理的局部决策，但当成功需要一系列依赖性动作和工具调用时，其性能会下降。在执行过程中，任务需求、历史证据以及当前执行状态可能会逐渐脱节，导致后续决策偏离原始目标。我们通过引入自适应一致性图（ACG）来研究这一问题，用于长时程执行。ACG将执行证据及其来源逐步组织在持久图中，然后在有限的上下文预算下为每个决策构建一个以需求为中心的临时视图。ACG并非替换基础代理的计划器或工具执行器，而是为每个决策提供结构化且可追溯的上下文视图。在匹配评估中，ACG将GPT-5.6-luna的平均成功率从使用ReAct时的44.5%提升至50.2%，其中在BrowseComp-Plus上的提升最大（从73.5%提升至62.4%）。我们进一步分析了轨迹结构和推理成本，以表征这一改进效果。

articles.title: Retrospective Distillation Attribution via Normalized Response Similarity
articles.abstract: Model distillation transfers capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher responses, often collected from commercial APIs, raising questions of model provenance. Existing distillation attribution methods have been largely evaluated on students immediately after the SFT step. However, a distilled model may undergo further SFT, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning before release, while an auditor may lack access to the pre-distillation checkpoint required by reference-based attribution. To close this gap, we propose SCOUT, an output-only method that aggregates recurring *syntactic patterns* into candidate profiles, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates student--candidate distances against inter-candidate distances. SCOUT supports attribution and abstention using only current texts, without model weights, token likelihoods, or historical checkpoints. Auditing publicly released descendants of distilled models spanning diverse post-training objectives, SCOUT consistently identifies the distillation source. Furthermore, tracing teacher-associated *syntactic signatures* along training trajectories reveals that they emerge during distillation and persist through subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning.
articles.titleCn: 基于归一化响应相似度的回顾性蒸馏归因
articles.abstractCn: 模型蒸馏通过在教师响应上进行监督微调（SFT）来转移能力，而教师响应通常从商业API中收集，这引发了模型来源的问题。现有的蒸馏归因方法主要在SFT步骤后的学生模型上进行评估。然而，蒸馏后的模型可能在发布前经历进一步的SFT、偏好优化或强化学习，而审计员可能无法获取参考归因所需的预蒸馏检查点。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了SCOUT，这是一种仅基于输出的方法，它将重复出现的*句法模式*聚合为候选配置文件，过滤低对比度模式，并根据候选模型间的距离校准学生与候选模型间的距离。SCOUT仅使用当前文本支持归因和回避，无需模型权重、标记似然或历史检查点。审计公开发布的蒸馏模型后代，涵盖多样化的后训练目标，SCOUT始终如一地识别出蒸馏来源。此外，通过沿着训练轨迹追踪与教师关联的*句法签名*，揭示它们在蒸馏过程中出现，并在后续的偏好优化和强化学习中持续存在。

articles.title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.
articles.titleCn: 基于梯度引导的解耦自适应方法用于地理空间视觉语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 现有的地理空间视觉语言模型（Geo-VLMs）通常通过统一的跨任务适应范式优化多种地理空间任务，而未明确考虑异构优化特性。我们的实证观察揭示了任务间的异构梯度特性，包括视觉-语言差异、分支内梯度关系和任务干扰，这些因素阻碍了有效的多任务优化。基于这些观察，我们提出了梯度引导解耦适应（G2DA），这是一个用于多任务Geo-VLM学习的梯度感知优化框架。G2DA首先通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦将任务划分为以视觉和语言为中心的组。然后基于任务梯度相似性构建模态特定课程，并采用双向演练来缓解序列优化引入的近期效应。我们在六个InternVL3和Qwen3.5-VL变体，以及GeoChat和GeoLLaVA上，使用三个Geo-VLM基准评估G2DA。在所有24个基准-模型组合中，G2DA始终优于代表性基线，在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite和VRS-Bench-VQA上分别比最强对手提高了3.08、4.30和2.81个百分点。这些结果表明，梯度引导的任务组织对于Geo-VLM适应是有效的。

articles.title: LLM Alignment--Utility Asymmetry under Semantic-Preserving Transformations
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment is intended to ensure that models remain helpful and safe, but its stability under input distributional shift is not yet fully understood. Prior work shows that aligned models can fail under jailbreak prompts, alternative encodings, and cross-lingual transfer, yet these failures are usually studied as attacks rather than controlled probes of alignment generalization. Moreover, existing evidence is largely grounded in natural language variation already represented during pretraining, leaving unresolved whether alignment generalizes with semantic content or remains tied to superficial surface patterns. In this paper, we study this question using synthetic semantic-preserving transformations that are rule-based and invertible, preserving task-relevant meaning while shifting inputs beyond standard linguistic variation. Across four open-weight and four commercial models, under both fine-tuning and in-context learning, we use these transformations as a probe of alignment generalization and identify an empirical pattern we term Alignment--utility asymmetry: once models can operate effectively on transformed inputs, task utility is often substantially retained while alignment failure increases more sharply. For example, adapted GPT-4.1 mini shows only limited utility degradation under transformation while its harmful rate rises from 13.3 to 74.3; Gemini 3 Flash similarly retains near-original utility while its harmful rate increases from 2.3 to 43.0. Taken together, these results suggest that semantic-preserving distribution shifts can expose a recurring gap in how utility and alignment generalize in current LLMs.
articles.titleCn: LLM对齐——语义保持转换下的效用不对称
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）对齐旨在确保模型保持有益和安全，但其输入分布偏移下的稳定性尚未完全理解。先前研究表明，对齐模型在越狱提示、替代编码和跨语言迁移下可能失效，但这些失效通常被视为攻击而非对齐泛化可控探测。此外，现有证据主要基于预训练期间已存在的自然语言变异，尚未解决对齐是否随语义内容泛化，还是仍与表面浅层模式相关的问题。本文通过使用基于规则且可逆的合成语义保留转换来研究这一问题，这些转换在改变输入超越标准语言变异的同时保留任务相关意义。在四个开放权重和四个商业模型上，无论进行微调还是在情境学习下，我们使用这些转换作为对齐泛化的探测工具，并识别出一种我们称为对齐-效用非对称性的经验模式：一旦模型能有效处理转换输入，任务效用通常大幅保留，而对齐失效则更急剧增加。例如，改造后的GPT-4.1 mini在转换下效用退化有限，但其有害率从13.3升至74.3；Gemini 3 Flash同样保留近原始效用，但其有害率从2.3升至43.0。综合来看，这些结果表明语义保留分布偏移可能揭示当前LLM在效用和对齐泛化方式上的一个反复出现的差距。

articles.title: MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute
articles.abstract: FullAttn often assigns negligible normalized mass to much of the causal score space, yet dense kernels execute the complete post-score path after forming each QK tile. We introduce MALA, a fused attention primitive that preserves score access to every legal causal interaction and uses normalized contribution to allocate post-score computation. Forward uses its evolving online-softmax normalizer, while backward reuses the finalized normalizer to derive nested retained support using only standard attention state. A common tolerance governs training and inference, allowing for adaptive retention of the work. MALA reduces low-contribution post-score computation. A matched-work study at 8K isolates the benefit of distribution-adaptive allocation: under exactly matched total post-score work, MALA approaches a per-instance reference-mass oracle, with mean omitted mass of 0.0188% versus 0.0182%. Across context lengths from 1K to 32K tokens, the same tolerance maintains low output and gradient errors relative to the reference. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison, MALA closely tracks FullAttn as context grows, reaching 89.67% accuracy at 8K compared with 89.97% for FullAttn. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, MALA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 2.2x and 3.0x and decoding latency during inference by 1.6x relative to FullAttn. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, MALA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results indicate that allocating post-score computation according to normalized attention contributions can retain the evaluated capabilities of FullAttn while reducing attention computation.
articles.titleCn: MassAlloc 注意力：让注意力自行分配其计算资源
articles.abstractCn: 全注意力机制（FullAttn）通常对大部分因果分数空间分配可忽略的归一化权重，而密集核在形成每个QK块后执行完整的后分数路径。我们引入了MALA（融合注意力原语），它保留了每个合法因果交互的分数访问，并使用归一化贡献来分配后分数计算。前向过程使用其演化的在线softmax归一化器，而反向过程重用最终确定的归一化器，仅使用标准注意力状态推导嵌套保留支持。一个通用的容差值控制训练和推理，允许自适应保留工作。MALA减少了低贡献的后分数计算。在8K的匹配工作量研究中，分离自适应分配的优势：在完全匹配的总后分数工作量下，MALA接近每个实例参考质量预言机，平均忽略质量为0.0188%对比0.0182%。在1K到32K token的上下文长度范围内，相同的容差值相对于参考维持了低输出和梯度误差。在更广泛的受控关联回忆比较中，随着上下文增长，MALA紧密跟踪FullAttn，在8K时达到89.67%的准确率，对比FullAttn的89.97%。在128K token的注意力算子基准测试中，使用张量并行，MALA在训练期间将前向和反向延迟减少了2.2倍和3.0倍，在推理期间将解码延迟减少了1.6倍，对比FullAttn。在从0.6B到14B参数的扩展率训练中，MALA在困惑度上紧密跟踪FullAttn，同时减少了总训练FLOPs。从分别继续训练得到的14B模型和32B模型，在知识、推理和长上下文检索分数上与FullAttn相当。这些结果表明，根据归一化注意力贡献分配后分数计算，可以在减少注意力计算的同时保留FullAttn评估的能力。

articles.title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time
articles.abstract: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicating whether the receiver inferred it correctly. This learning occurs during inference with fixed parameters and no supplied codebook or encoding examples. The effect also persists when agents generate their own free-form updates in a simulated incident-response task. Across ten independent games, pairs of GPT-5.6 Sol agents reach 98.8% final accuracy, compared with 25% chance, despite explicit instructions prohibiting disclosure and a monitor that screens each message without access to the agents' interaction histories. The same interactions that help agents cooperate can therefore allow confidential information to pass through messages intended for legitimate coordination.
articles.titleCn: 无视指令：边境代理在测试时临时建立秘密渠道
articles.abstractCn: 在安全敏感的应用中，语言模型代理通常需要在不泄露机密信息的情况下进行协调。然而，重复交互也可能使普通消息获得共享的私密含义。我们研究了一个包含模型对的双重复杂博弈，其中发送模型观察四种秘密状态之一，并从四种相同公共报告的摘要中选择一种，而接收模型试图推断秘密状态。我们发现，模型对可以通过仅使用一个表示接收模型是否正确推断的反馈位来学习传递秘密。这种学习发生在具有固定参数且未提供代码簿或编码示例的推理过程中。当代理在模拟事件响应任务中生成自己的自由格式更新时，这种效果仍然存在。在十个独立游戏中，GPT-5.6 Sol 模型对最终准确率达到 98.8%，而随机猜测仅为 25%，尽管有明确的指令禁止泄露，并且有一个监控器在不访问代理交互历史的情况下筛选每条消息。因此，那些帮助代理合作的交互也可能使机密信息通过旨在进行合法协调的消息传递。

articles.title: IGSD: Environment-Verified Hindsight Self-Distillation for Search Agents
articles.abstract: On-policy self-distillation densifies agent training without external teachers: a policy conditioned on privileged hindsight provides step-level guidance for its own unprivileged rollouts. For search agents, however, hindsight can make the teacher prefer a query that does not improve retrieval from the student's state. Existing methods either distill this preference directly or filter it with model-internal scores, but neither strategy verifies the query's executed retrieval consequence. We propose Information-Gain-Gated Self-Distillation (IGSD), which verifies on-policy token proposals with environment feedback before distilling them. Treating each query token as a micro-action, IGSD completes the teacher's token proposal and the student's sampled token into matched queries and executes both from the same failed state with the same retriever. Shared counterfactual controls account for query-conditioned shifts in answer likelihood, so their difference, the executed paired information gain, provides a relative utility contrast for the retrieved documents. IGSD uses this contrast as a positive-only soft weight for candidate-pair distillation, while leaving the GRPO objective unchanged and confining verification to training. Across seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks, IGSD reaches macro-average exact-match accuracies of 42.8% and 47.0% with 3B and 7B policies, respectively, without inference-time verification. These results support environment-verified hindsight as an effective approach to reliable action-level supervision for search agents.
articles.titleCn: IGSD：环境验证的后见之明自蒸馏搜索代理
articles.abstractCn: 基于策略的自蒸馏技术无需外部教师即可密集化智能体训练：一个基于特权后见之明的策略为其自身的无特权部署提供步骤级指导。然而，对于搜索智能体而言，后见之明可能导致教师倾向于一个不会提升从学生状态检索效果的查询。现有方法要么直接蒸馏这种偏好，要么通过模型内部评分进行过滤，但两种策略均未验证查询的执行检索后果。我们提出了信息增益门控自蒸馏（IGSD），该技术在蒸馏前通过环境反馈验证策略中的词元提议。将每个查询词元视为微动作，IGSD将教师的词元提议和学生采样的词元组合成匹配查询，并从相同的失败状态使用相同的检索器执行两者。共享反事实控制考虑了查询条件下的答案可能性变化，因此它们的差异，即执行的配对信息增益，为检索到的文档提供了相对效用对比。IGSD使用这种对比作为候选对蒸馏的唯一正值软权重，同时保持GRPO目标不变并将验证限制在训练中。在七个单跳和多跳问答基准测试中，IGSD使用3B和7B策略分别达到了42.8%和47.0%的宏观平均精确匹配准确率，且无需推理时验证。这些结果支持环境验证的后见之明作为搜索智能体可靠动作级监督的有效方法。

articles.title: Focusing Condition: Inference-Time Self-Contrastive Steering Elicits Better Conditional Text Embeddings in LLMs
articles.abstract: Extracting conditional text embeddings from large language models (LLMs) is a promising paradigm, as it requires neither additional data nor fine-tuning. Existing methods incorporate conditions into prompts to guide LLMs to focus on specific aspects and elicit conditional text embeddings. However, relying solely on prompts often fails to produce high-quality conditional text embeddings, as they remain entangled with general text embeddings, ultimately degrading their quality. To this end, we propose an inference-time, plug-and-play Self-Contrastive Steering (SCS) method that constructs unconditional general text embeddings and uses them to refine conditional text embeddings, making them more focused on the target condition. Specifically, we modify the attention mask and positional encodings to mask the condition, thereby obtaining unconditional text embeddings and intervening in the multi-head self-attention computation process. Notably, our method is highly efficient, requiring only a single additional multi-head self-attention computation at inference time. Extensive experiments on clustering, Semantic Textual Similarity, and triplet alignment datasets demonstrate that our method can seamlessly improve the performance of existing prompt-based methods across different LLMs in a training-free and plug-and-play manner. Our code will be released at https://github.com/zifengcheng/SCS
articles.titleCn: 聚焦条件：推理时自对比引导在大型语言模型中产生更好的条件文本嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 从大型语言模型（LLMs）中提取条件文本嵌入是一种有前景的范式，因为它既不需要额外数据也不需要微调。现有方法将条件融入提示中，以引导LLMs专注于特定方面并提取条件文本嵌入。然而，仅依赖提示往往无法生成高质量的条件文本嵌入，因为它们仍然与通用文本嵌入纠缠在一起，最终降低了其质量。为此，我们提出了一种推理时、即插即用的自对比引导（SCS）方法，该方法构建无条件的通用文本嵌入，并利用它们来优化条件文本嵌入，使其更专注于目标条件。具体而言，我们修改了注意力掩码和位置编码以掩盖条件，从而获得无条件的文本嵌入并干预多头自注意力计算过程。值得注意的是，我们的方法效率极高，仅在推理时需要一次额外的多头自注意力计算。在聚类、语义文本相似性和三元组对齐数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法能够在无需训练且即插即用的方式下，无缝提升现有基于提示方法在不同LLMs上的性能。我们的代码将发布在 https://github.com/zifengcheng/SCS。

articles.title: The GUI Is Not the State: Diagnosing State Aliasing in GUI World Models
articles.abstract: GUI World Models (GUI-WMs) are increasingly used to predict future states for agent planning and simulation, yet most existing formulations condition only on the current GUI observation and action. We identify state aliasing, where the vis- ible interface omits transition-relevant environment state, so identical observable conditions can correspond to different valid futures. To diagnose this failure mode, we introduce StateAliasBench, a diagnostic benchmark that explicitly isolates such ambiguities via strict pairing. We further propose lightweight predictive- state recovery that infers structured state from history and augments otherwise frozen GUI-WMs through a deterministic state interface. Family-specific special- ists provide state recovery across heterogeneous state types, and multi-teacher dis- tillation consolidates them into a single unified estimator. Experiments show that existing GUI-WMs exhibit systematic failures under observation-only condition- ing, while predictive-state augmentation substantially restores state-sensitive pre- diction across evaluated WMs, preserves generative fidelity, and improves down- stream performance of GUI agents on AndroidWorld. These results suggest that reliable GUI world modeling should account not only for what is visible, but also for the hidden transition state that determines what happens next.
articles.titleCn: GUI不是状态：诊断GUI世界模型中的状态别名问题
articles.abstractCn: 图形用户界面世界模型（GUI-WMs）越来越多地用于预测智能体规划与模拟的未来状态，然而现有的大多数模型仅基于当前的GUI观测和动作进行条件化。我们识别出状态别名问题，即可见界面遗漏了与状态转换相关的环境状态，导致相同的可观测条件可能对应不同的有效未来。为了诊断这种失效模式，我们引入了StateAliasBench，这是一个通过严格配对明确隔离此类歧义的诊断基准。我们进一步提出了轻量级预测状态恢复方法，该方法从历史记录中推断结构化状态，并通过确定性状态接口增强原本冻结的GUI-WMs。特定家族的专家提供跨异构状态类型的恢复功能，而多导师蒸馏将它们整合为单一统一估计器。实验表明，在仅基于观测的条件化下，现有的GUI-WMs表现出系统性的失效，而预测状态增强能显著恢复评估的WMs中的状态敏感预测，同时保持生成保真度，并提升AndroidWorld上GUI智能体的下游性能。这些结果表明，可靠的GUI世界建模不仅要考虑可见的内容，还要考虑决定后续发生什么隐藏的状态转换状态。

articles.title: Distance-KV: Exploiting Relative Distance for Efficient Long-Context Inference
articles.abstract: The memory usage and decoding latency of LLM inference grow rapidly with context length. To reduce these costs, key-value (KV) cache compression methods selectively retain cached states based on token importance or differences in attention patterns across heads. However, we discover that retrieval capability varies substantially with relative distance, even within the same attention head. To exploit this structure, we introduce Distance-KV, which learns a static KV retention pattern over the joint space of layers, attention heads, and relative distances. The pattern is learned offline with the language model frozen and reused across inputs to prune and compact the KV cache without online importance scoring. Across three backbone models and four long-context benchmarks, Distance-KV consistently achieves the best overall performance among competing KV cache compression methods, exceeding the strongest compression baseline by up to 9.3 points on RULER at 128K. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 128K, Distance-KV reduces KV cache memory by 65.4% and achieves a $1.66\times$ decoding speedup relative to Dense. Together, these results identify relative distance as an important structural dimension for understanding how LLMs retrieve information over long contexts and for designing more efficient inference methods.
articles.titleCn: 距离-KV：利用相对距离实现高效长上下文推理
articles.abstractCn: LLM推理的内存使用和解码延迟随着上下文长度的增加而迅速增长。为了降低这些成本，键值（KV）缓存压缩方法根据标记重要性或不同注意力头之间的注意力模式差异来选择性地保留缓存状态。然而，我们发现检索能力在相对距离上差异很大，即使在同一个注意力头内部也是如此。为了利用这种结构，我们引入了Distance-KV，它学习在层、注意力头和相对距离的联合空间中学习一个静态的KV保留模式。该模式在语言模型冻结的情况下离线学习，并在不同输入中重复使用，以在不进行在线重要性评分的情况下剪枝和压缩KV缓存。在三个骨干模型和四个长上下文基准测试中，Distance-KV在竞争的KV缓存压缩方法中始终表现最佳，在RULER上达到128K时，其性能比最强的压缩基线高出高达9.3个百分点。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上达到128K时，Distance-KV将KV缓存内存减少65.4%，并相对于密集模型实现了1.66倍的解码加速。这些结果共同表明，相对距离是理解LLM如何在长上下文中检索信息以及设计更高效推理方法的重要结构维度。

articles.title: From Knowing to Abstaining: Bridging the Representation-Action Gap in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to abstain from unanswerable questions is as important as their ability to answer answerable ones accurately. Recently, several benchmarks have emerged to evaluate and improve VLM abstention, but they have substantial limitations. First, samples often contain shortcut cues in images or questions that reveal answerability, while an explicit "unanswerable" option further prevents accurate assessment of spontaneous abstention. Second, as training data, they generally provide only binary labels without fine-grained explanations for deeper supervision. To address these limitations, we introduce Visual Answerability Diagnosis with Rationales (VAD-R), a benchmark constructed through a two-stage pipeline of shortcut filtering and quality verification to prevent answerability leakage. Each example is annotated with step-by-step rationales and causal evidence-gap labels. Evaluation of state-of-the-art open- and closed-source VLMs on VAD-R reveals limited spontaneous abstention, with average recall rates of only 11.4% and 16.3%, respectively. Probing analyses show that hidden-state representations in certain layers can effectively distinguish answerability, yet this distinction fails to manifest in final responses. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rep2Act, a representation-to-action alignment method that translates latent answerability awareness into explicit abstention decisions. Rep2Act improves action accuracy on VAD-R from 56.67% to 86.33% for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and from 59.33% to 88.67% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B. On the out-of-distribution TUBench, Rep2Act achieves an average F1 score of 53.3% with only a 3B model, surpassing the closed-source GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-4o by 16.2% and 1.1%, respectively.
articles.titleCn: 从认知到戒断：弥合视觉语言模型中的表征-行动差距
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在回避无解问题时，其能力与准确回答可解问题同样重要。近期，出现了几个用于评估和改进VLM回避能力的基准，但它们存在显著局限性。首先，样本中的图像或问题常常包含提示答案可行性的捷径线索，而明确的无解选项进一步阻碍了对自发回避的准确评估。其次，作为训练数据，它们通常仅提供二元标签，缺乏用于深度监督的细粒度解释。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了基于推理的视觉可解性诊断（VAD-R），这是一个通过捷径过滤和质量验证两阶段流程构建的基准，以防止可解性泄露。每个示例都标注了逐步推理和因果证据差距标签。在VAD-R上对当前最先进的开源和闭源VLMs的评估显示，自发回避能力有限，平均召回率分别仅为11.4%和16.3%。探测分析表明，某些层中的隐藏状态表示能有效区分可解性，但这种区分并未在最终响应中体现。基于这一观察，我们引入了表示到行动对齐方法Rep2Act，将潜在的答案意识转化为明确的回避决策。Rep2Act将Qwen2.5-VL-3B在VAD-R上的行动准确率从56.67%提升至86.33%，将Qwen2.5-VL-7B从59.33%提升至88.67%。在分布外基准TUBench上，Rep2Act仅使用3B模型就实现了平均F1分数53.3%，分别比闭源GPT-4 Turbo和GPT-4o高16.2%和1.1%。

articles.title: ExpVoyager: Direct Experience Navigation for Dynamic Agent Skill Synthesis
articles.abstract: Learning from experience in LLM agents has become a key paradigm for developing self-evolving agents that continuously learn and expand their capabilities. Within this paradigm, synthesizing the agent skill has emerged as a promising solution for transforming accumulated experience into reusable procedural knowledge, serving as an important layer for the harness system that supplies agents at runtime. Despite its potential, existing approaches largely abstract past experience into fixed procedural knowledge before downstream demands are known, which risks discarding knowledge that later becomes critical while retaining instance-specific details irrelevant to future tasks. In this paper, we reframe agent skill synthesis as a dynamic navigation problem over past experience, where agents actively explore accumulated trajectories on demand for the current task with targeted and fine-grained access to experience knowledge. To this end, we propose ExpVoyager, a novel framework in which a skill curator navigates raw experience across different views and resolutions, continually identifying reusable procedural knowledge from what it observes while tracking remaining knowledge needs that guide where to navigate next. Extensive experiments demonstrate both the effectiveness and versatility of ExpVoyager, showing consistent improvements in downstream task performance, continual gains as the experience space scales, and practical compatibility with existing skills under efficient experience access.
articles.titleCn: ExpVoyager：动态智能体技能合成中的直接经验导航
articles.abstractCn: 从LLM代理的经验中学习已成为开发自我进化代理的关键范式，这些代理能够持续学习和扩展其能力。在此范式下，代理技能合成已成为将积累的经验转化为可重用程序性知识的一种有前景的解决方案，为在运行时向代理提供支持的 harness 系统构成了一个重要层次。尽管具有潜力，现有方法在下游需求明确之前，通常将过去经验抽象为固定的程序性知识，这存在丢弃后来变得关键的知识，同时保留与未来任务无关的特定实例细节的风险。在本文中，我们将代理技能合成重新定义为在经验上的动态导航问题，代理根据当前任务的需求，主动探索积累的轨迹，并以目标明确和细粒度的方式访问经验知识。为此，我们提出了 ExpVoyager，这是一个新颖的框架，其中技能策展人（skill curator）在不同视图和分辨率之间导航原始经验，在观察到的内容中持续识别可重用的程序性知识，同时跟踪剩余的知识需求，以指导下一步的导航方向。广泛的实验证明了 ExpVoyager 的有效性和多功能性，展示了其在下游任务性能上的持续改进、随着经验空间扩展的持续收益，以及在高效经验访问下的与现有技能的实用兼容性。

articles.title: MixDetect: Word-Level Localization and Quantification of AI Editing
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to edit human-written text rather than generate entire texts from scratch. Conventional AI-text detectors mainly distinguish human-written from fully AI-generated text, while recent methods for AI-edited text typically provide only a text-level label or editing-degree score. We introduce MixDetect, a word-level framework for localizing and quantifying AI editing. MixDetect separately predicts whether each word has been edited and, conditional on editing, how substantial the edit is, allowing editing scope and editing intensity to be estimated separately. During training, source--edited pairs are aligned to construct word-level supervision, while inference requires only the input text. Experiments show that MixDetect accurately localizes AI-edited words, reflects differences in editing intensity, and reveals different scope--intensity patterns across editing degrees and operations. The overall AI editing magnitude increases under additional AI editing, decreases when AI-generated text is edited by humans, and remains nearly unchanged under ordinary human-to-human editing. The aggregated text-level predictions also perform well on binary and ternary AI-text classification and remain effective under domain and generator shifts. These results show that AI editing can be analyzed beyond a single authorship label or editing-degree score by identifying both where AI editing occurs and how substantial the edits are.
articles.titleCn: MixDetect：AI编辑的词级定位与量化
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于编辑人类撰写的文本，而不是从零开始生成整个文本。传统的AI文本检测器主要区分人类撰写的文本与完全由AI生成的文本，而最近针对AI编辑文本的方法通常只提供文本级别的标签或编辑程度分数。我们介绍了MixDetect，这是一个用于定位和量化AI编辑的词级框架。MixDetect分别预测每个词是否已被编辑，并在编辑的情况下预测编辑的程度，从而可以分别估计编辑范围和编辑强度。在训练过程中，源编辑对被对齐以构建词级监督，而推理只需要输入文本。实验表明，MixDetect能够准确定位AI编辑的词，反映编辑强度的差异，并揭示不同编辑程度和操作下的范围-强度模式。在额外AI编辑的情况下，整体AI编辑幅度增加；当AI生成的文本被人类编辑时，编辑幅度减少；而在普通人类间编辑的情况下，编辑幅度几乎保持不变。聚合的文本级别预测在二元和三元AI文本分类上也表现良好，并在领域和生成器迁移下保持有效。这些结果表明，通过识别AI编辑发生的位置以及编辑的实质性，可以对AI编辑进行分析，而不仅仅是基于单一作者标签或编辑程度分数。

articles.title: Does CoT-Pass@k Really Check the CoT? A Multilingual Mathematical Audit
articles.abstract: Pass@k measures whether a model reaches a correct answer under repeated sampling, but never how: a lucky guess counts the same as sound reasoning. CoT-Pass@k was proposed to close that gap, adding an LLM-as-judge that must assess a solution's reasoning chain before it counts. Its value rests entirely on one assumption: that the judge catches flawed reasoning. That assumption has never been tested inside the metric that depends on it, and never outside English, though the metric's claims concern models used in many languages. We report the first audit of that verification step, run under the metric's own protocol on a multilingual suite of five mathematical benchmarks in English, Turkish and Portuguese, two of them natively written. We corrupt correct solutions with deterministic edits that damage the chain and the final answer separately. We observe that all three judges accept corrupted chains almost as often as clean ones. V4-Flash and Qwen3.6 reject a solution sharply only when its final answer is wrong and accept a wrong answer more readily when the chain agrees with it; the metric's own judge accepts most wrong answers as well. Our study shows that chain-answer agreement dominates the two larger judges' verdicts and that all three fail to reliably detect the tested reasoning errors. Consequently the difference Pass@k - CoT-Pass@k averages 19.7 points on an earlier solver generation but only 4.1 on the current one. What little remains depends on the token budgets on both sides and on the generation mode; raising the generation budget moves Pass@64 by more than fifty points while the difference stays at zero. We close with two checks any judged reasoning metric should pass before its numbers are read as evidence about reasoning.

articles.titleCn: CoT-Pass@k 真的检查 CoT 吗？一项多语言数学审计
articles.abstractCn: Pass@k 衡量模型在重复采样下是否达到正确答案，但从未衡量其方式：侥幸猜测与合理推理被同等对待。CoT-Pass@k 被提出以弥补这一差距，增加了一个将大型语言模型作为裁判的角色，该裁判必须在计分前评估解决方案的推理链。其价值完全基于一个假设：裁判能够捕捉到有缺陷的推理。这一假设从未在依赖它的指标内部进行过测试，也从未在英语之外进行过测试，尽管该指标声称其涉及多种语言中使用的模型。我们报告了首次对该验证步骤的审计，该审计在指标自身的协议下，对一套包含英语、土耳其语和葡萄牙语（其中两种语言为原生编写）的五个数学基准测试进行。我们对正确解决方案进行确定性编辑，分别破坏推理链和最终答案。我们观察到，所有三个裁判几乎以与干净链相同的频率接受被破坏的链。V4-Flash 和 Qwen3.6 只有当最终答案错误时才会严厉拒绝解决方案，并且当推理链与错误答案一致时更容易接受错误答案；指标自身的裁判也接受大多数错误答案。我们的研究表明，推理链与答案的一致性主导了两个较大裁判的裁决，并且所有三个裁判都无法可靠地检测到所测试的推理错误。因此，Pass@k - CoT-Pass@k 的差异在早期求解器版本上平均为19.7分，但在当前版本上仅为4.1分。所剩无几的差异取决于双方的计算预算和生成模式；提高生成预算使 Pass@64 提高了超过50分，而差异仍保持在零分。我们最后提出两个任何被评判的推理指标在数字被作为推理证据之前必须通过的标准检查。

articles.title: The Alignment Paradox: How Post-Training Amplifies Confident Hallucinations in Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can produce factually incorrect answers with high confidence, undermining their reliability and limiting the effectiveness of uncertainty-based error detection. While prior research attributes confident hallucinations to factors such as missing knowledge in training data, reasoning errors, or stochastic decoding, we uncover that post-training alignment itself is a primary driver of these errors, a phenomenon we call the \textbf{Alignment Paradox}. Across five model families evaluated on factual benchmarks, unaligned base models produce few high-confidence errors on long-tail factual queries, whereas instruction-tuned models multiply high-confidence errors ($p \ge 0.95$) by more than an order of magnitude (10$\times$ to 35$\times$). Layer-wise probing with the Logit Lens reveals that this overconfidence emerges in late layers, where wrong-answer margins expand past 4.0 points after remaining near zero across early and intermediate layers. These findings motivate limiting margin growth during post-training. We implement this principle through an entropy-dependent margin bound in direct preference optimization (DPO). In multi-epoch experiments with Mistral-7B, the bounded objective reduces high-confidence errors by up to 35.3\% relative to standard DPO while maintaining performance on evaluated general reasoning benchmarks. These results show that bounded margins mitigate confident hallucinations during post-training.
articles.titleCn: 对齐悖论：训练后如何放大语言模型中的自信幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可能会以极高的置信度生成事实性错误答案，从而削弱其可靠性，并限制基于不确定性的错误检测的有效性。先前研究将自信的幻觉归因于训练数据中的知识缺失、推理错误或随机解码等因素，而我们揭示出，训练后对齐本身就是这些错误的主要驱动因素，我们称之为\textbf{对齐悖论}。在五个在事实基准上评估的模型家族中，未对齐的基模型在长尾事实查询上产生的低置信度错误很少，而指令微调模型则使高置信度错误（$p \ge 0.95$）数量增加了十倍至三十五倍。通过Logit Lens进行的逐层探测显示，这种过度自信出现在晚期层，错误答案的边际在早期和中间层保持接近零后，在晚期层扩展至超过4.0分。这些发现促使我们在训练后阶段限制边际增长。我们通过在直接偏好优化（DPO）中实现基于熵的边际界限来贯彻这一原则。在Mistral-7B的多周期实验中，受约束的目标相对于标准DPO将高置信度错误降低了高达35.3%，同时在评估的通用推理基准上保持了性能。这些结果表明，受约束的边际能够在训练后阶段缓解自信的幻觉。

articles.title: KV-Lingo: Learning KV-Cache Translators with Distillation
articles.abstract: Large language models represent context with a key-value (KV) cache. Caches are model-specific: for the same text, models with different architectures or weights produce incompatible representations. This makes it costly to switch models over a shared context: although the context has already been processed by one model, the incoming model must process it again to build its own cache. We introduce KV-Lingo, a method for translating the KV cache of a source model into one that can be read by a target model. KV-Lingo consists of a collection of linear maps, typically one per layer of the target model, that are applied independently on all tokens' key and value representations. We train these maps using distillation, minimising the divergence between the target model's predictions from its native cache and those from the translated cache. We consider several model pairs spanning multiple sizes and architectures, training one translator per pair on a generic text corpus. The resulting translators preserve strong downstream performance in both small-to-large and large-to-small transfers. Since a switch then costs a linear map and a single decoding step instead of a prefill, replacing re-prefill with cache translation reduces the time to first token after a model switch by 9.6x already on a 64-token prompt for Qwen models on an Apple M3 Ultra, and by up to 29x at 32k context length on an H100. These gains make KV-Lingo particularly useful for dynamic model routing: a context can be processed by one model and handed off to another only when needed, without re-prefilling the shared prefix. We finally show that KV-Lingo can be used for seamless model switching, staying close to re-prefill across repeated switches in our multi-turn evaluations.
articles.titleCn: KV-Lingo：通过蒸馏学习KV缓存翻译器
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通过键值（KV）缓存来表示上下文。缓存是模型特定的：对于相同文本，具有不同架构或权重的模型会产生不兼容的表示。这使得在共享上下文中切换模型变得昂贵：尽管上下文已经被一个模型处理过，但新模型必须再次处理它以构建自己的缓存。我们引入了KV-Lingo，这是一种将源模型的KV缓存转换为可以被目标模型读取的方法。KV-Lingo由一组线性映射组成，通常每个目标模型的层都有一个，这些映射独立地应用于所有标记的键和值表示。我们使用蒸馏来训练这些映射，最小化目标模型基于其原生缓存和翻译缓存的预测之间的差异。我们考虑了多个跨越多种大小和架构的模型对，在每个对上使用通用文本语料库训练一个翻译器。得到的翻译器在从小到大和大到小的迁移中都能保持强大的下游性能。由于切换只需要一个线性映射和一个单步解码，而不是预填充，用缓存翻译替换重新预填充将减少模型切换后第一个标记的时间：在Apple M3 Ultra上的Qwen模型64标记提示中，时间减少了9.6倍，在H100上32k上下文长度时，时间最多减少了29倍。这些收益使KV-Lingo特别适用于动态模型路由：上下文可以在需要时由一个模型处理并传递给另一个模型，而无需重新预填充共享前缀。最后，我们展示了KV-Lingo可用于无缝模型切换，在我们的多轮评估中，重复切换时接近重新预填充。

articles.title: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
articles.abstract: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form. We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on those same messages improves it by 2.31. Delivery is the larger term on all three MemLens backbones and grows with backbone strength; retrieval grows too, without closing the gap. We propose DeliverMem, an instantiation of delivery as three decisions: keep the original modality, give each item a readable identity, and state when it was seen, with a retrieval-side adapter for the one property delivery cannot supply. Each is measured against a delivery-matched control that alters only its own variable. DeliverMem leads the strongest published memory agent on MemLens at all four context lengths, and beats DMV-Bench's own strongest method at every setting on both backbones. On MemLens it does this on a tenth to a seventieth of the input. Each decision helps only where the question lacks what it supplies, and is null elsewhere. A single fixed configuration nonetheless leads both benchmarks, without training any component or modifying the stored records. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
articles.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
articles.titleCn: 已检索但未送达：长期代理的多模态记忆传递
articles.abstractCn: 多模态智能体的记忆工作优化了写入、更新和检索的内容。然而，在检索和答案之间，多模态记忆评估并未区分的一个阶段是：检索到的记忆中有哪些内容到达了模型，以及以何种形式到达。我们称之为“传递”，在MemLens上的受控分解定位了其中的剩余空间。当检索到的证据集完全固定时，传递原始像素而不是隐藏它们，在8B主干上提高了13.87分的准确率，而在这相同消息上使检索完美则提高了2.31分。传递在所有三个MemLens主干上都是更主要的因素，并且随着主干强度的增强而增长；检索也在增长，但并未缩小差距。我们提出了DeliverMem，它将传递实例化为三个决策：保留原始模态、为每个项目赋予可读的标识，以及声明其被看到的时间，并附带一个用于传递无法提供的单一属性的检索端适配器。每一项决策都通过与仅改变其自身变量的传递匹配对照进行测量。DeliverMem在MemLens上所有四种上下文长度中都领先于最强的已发表记忆智能体，并且在两个主干上以所有设置都击败了DMV-Bench自身的最强方法。在MemLens上，它仅使用了输入的十分之一到七十分之一。每个决策仅在问题缺少其提供的内容时才有所帮助，而在其他地方则无效。尽管如此，单一固定的配置仍然赢得了两个基准测试，而无需训练任何组件或修改存储记录。项目页面：https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/

articles.title: HERO-MoE: Historical Expert Routing with Scale-Preserving Fusion
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become a standard way to scale model capacity while keeping computation sparse, yet routing remains a key determinant of MoE quality and training behavior. Prior empirical studies suggest that MoE routing reflects input semantics and upstream computation across depth, but standard routers do not explicitly use the routing distributions produced by preceding layers. We propose HERO-MoE, Historical Expert ROuting with Scale-Preserving Fusion, a routing framework that injects historical routing priors into MoE routers by reusing detached, dense routing distributions collected from preceding MoE layers. The key idea is simple: HERO-MoE preserves the original token-conditioned routing branch and adds a residual historical routing contribution before the standard softmax and top-$k$ dispatch. To stabilize this historical signal, HERO-MoE introduces a scale-preserving fusion mechanism that matches the magnitude of historical routing memory to the current hidden representation and accounts for the number of visible historical layers, without introducing an auxiliary routing loss or a fusion-specific tuning parameter. By reusing routing distributions already computed by preceding MoE layers, HERO-MoE improves training-loss reduction with modest end-to-end overhead. The resulting router remains compatible with standard sparse dispatch, including top-$k$ and group-limited routing, and can be inserted into existing MoE backbones with minimal architectural changes. Experiments on an approximately 8B-parameter MoE model with 0.5B active parameters, trained from scratch on 100B tokens, show that HERO-MoE reduces the final loss from 1.6393 to 1.6184, while peak memory and FLOPs increase by only 0.44\% and 0.64\%, respectively.
articles.titleCn: HERO-MoE：历史专家路由与规模保持融合
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）架构已成为在保持计算稀疏性的同时扩展模型容量的标准方法，但路由仍然是决定MoE质量和训练行为的关键因素。先前的实证研究表明，MoE路由反映了输入语义和跨深度的上游计算，但标准路由器并未明确使用先前层产生的路由分布。我们提出了HERO-MoE，即历史专家路由与尺度保持融合，这是一种将历史路由先验注入MoE路由器的路由框架，通过重用从先前MoE层收集的分离的密集路由分布来实现。其核心思想很简单：HERO-MoE保留了原始的token条件路由分支，并在标准的softmax和top-k调度之前添加了一个残差历史路由贡献。为了稳定这个历史信号，HERO-MoE引入了一种尺度保持融合机制，该机制将历史路由内存的幅度与当前隐藏表示相匹配，并考虑可见历史层数，而无需引入辅助路由损失或融合特定的调谐参数。通过重用先前MoE层已计算的路由分布，HERO-MoE在适度的端到端开销下提高了训练损失的降低。由此产生的路由器仍然与标准的稀疏调度兼容，包括top-k和组限制路由，并且可以插入现有的MoE主干结构，只需最少的架构更改。在约80亿参数的MoE模型（其中0.5亿参数为激活参数）上进行的实验表明，HERO-MoE将最终损失从1.6393降低到1.6184，同时峰值内存和FLOPs分别仅增加了0.44%和0.64%。

articles.title: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for code agents often uses executable tests to provide binary rewards. With these rewards, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns identical advantages to test-passing trajectories within each rollout group, overlooking differences in implementation quality and adherence to task requirements. This leaves the policy without a learning signal that favors clean, targeted implementations over those containing unnecessary or out-of-scope changes. We introduce GAGAR, a framework for quality-aware credit redistribution in code agent RL. Built on dynamic sampling that retains groups containing both passing and failing trajectories, GAGAR places all trajectories from each group in a shared workspace, where an SFT-trained agentic grader jointly inspects them and ranks the test-passing candidates. Based on this ranking, we downweight lower-ranked trajectories and proportionally rescale the advantages of all test-passing trajectories to restore their original sum. This sum-preserving redistribution retains the relative weights established by quality-based downweighting while shifting credit toward higher-quality implementations. We evaluate GAGAR at industrial scale using pre-RL SFT checkpoints of MiMo-V2.6-Flash (310B total parameters) and MiMo-V2.6-Pro (1.02T total parameters). Controlled code-only Flash experiments show improved code agent performance, reduced trajectory-length growth, and more stable training. We further apply GAGAR in large-scale mixed-task RL with both Flash and Pro. Our results support combining test-based verification with groupwise agentic grading to improve the quality and stability of code agent RL.
articles.titleCn: 组内代理评分与优势再分配用于代码代理强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）在代码智能体中的应用通常使用可执行测试来提供二元奖励。利用这些奖励，组相对策略优化（GRPO）会对每个回滚组内的通过测试的轨迹分配相同的优势，而忽略了实现质量和任务要求遵循程度上的差异。这导致策略缺乏学习信号，无法区分干净、有针对性的实现与包含不必要或超出范围的更改的实现。我们引入了GAGAR，这是一个用于代码智能体RL中质量感知的信用再分配框架。基于动态采样，保留包含通过和失败轨迹的组，GAGAR将每个组内的所有轨迹置于共享工作区，由SFT训练的代理评分员共同检查并排名通过测试的候选者。基于此排名，我们降低低排名轨迹的权重，并将所有通过测试轨迹的优势按比例缩放，以恢复其原始总和。这种总和保持的再分配保留了基于质量降低的相对权重，同时将信用向高质量实现转移。我们使用MiMo-V2.6-Flash（3100亿总参数）和MiMo-V2.6-Pro（10.2万亿总参数）的预RL SFT检查点，在工业规模上评估GAGAR。受控的代码仅Flash实验表明，代码智能体性能得到提升，轨迹长度增长减少，训练更加稳定。我们进一步将GAGAR应用于包含Flash和Pro的大规模混合任务RL。我们的结果表明，结合基于测试的验证与组内代理评分，可以有效提高代码智能体RL的质量和稳定性。

articles.title: CUE-Mem: Benchmarking Long-Term User Memory via Implicit Cues in Multimodal Conversations
articles.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents that interact with users across sustained conversations. However, user memories are not always explicitly stated: they may also be implied by recurring background objects in images, ambient sounds in audio, or other peripheral multimodal cues. Existing benchmarks largely focus on text-only memory or explicit multimodal evidence, leaving implicit multimodal cues underexplored. We introduce CUE-Mem, a text-image-audio benchmark for evaluating long-term user memory from implicit cues. CUE-Mem contains 2,674 questions across explicit and implicit evidence settings and covers four tasks: Entity Recall, Long Pattern, Personalized Recommendation, and Answer Refusal. Across textualized memory systems, implicit performance remains far below oracle evidence, locating the main bottleneck in preserving and retrieving subtle cues rather than question answerability. Increasing caption detail recovers more of this evidence, but brings uneven gains and rapidly growing token costs, motivating native multimodal access. Yet native access does not uniformly resolve the bottleneck: evidence use depends strongly on the backbone, while multimodal indexing introduces substantial retrieval noise. CUE-Mem provides a testbed for memory systems that selectively retain, retrieve, and use subtle multimodal evidence.
