articles.titleCn: 从内部支持与呈现文化
articles.abstractCn: 人类学与相关研究文化的学科经常发现，从内部视角（即文化成员如何看待世界）与外部视角（即对文化知识与行为的科学分类）的角度来考虑其认识论和方法论方法是有用的。这是内部视角与外部视角之间的区别。我们采用这一框架，对自然语言处理（NLP）中关于文化的最新研究沿任务选择、数据收集、系统设计和评估的全流程中的假设进行系统分析。我们关注塑造我们领域研究重点和方法的“NLP文化”，并提出了通往更具文化适应性的人工智能的途径。

articles.title: Before Answering: Evidence Sufficiency under Size-Matched Memory Construction
articles.abstract: Agents that answer questions from compressed or retrieved memory must recognize when the evidence a query needs is no longer in memory. Benchmarks for this task usually create insufficient-evidence examples by deleting supporting passages. We show that this construction leaks the label through memory size: on MuSiQue, a classifier that only counts paragraphs reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of $0.979$ for detecting unsafe memory, higher than the lexical estimator we initially evaluated. We propose a size-matched construction that provably removes this shortcut, and use it to study MemSafe, an estimator that cross-encodes the query with each memory unit and aggregates the units with a set transformer. Across three multi-hop question answering datasets and five seeds, MemSafe reaches $0.968$ and $0.983$ AUROC on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, $0.26$ to $0.39$ above a lexical baseline, while the third dataset, 2WikiMultiHopQA, is saturated. A frozen pretrained cross-encoder with a logistic head already closes $41\%$ of the MuSiQue gap between the lexical baseline and MemSafe. At the same time, MemSafe degrades more than a weak baseline on the unanswerable questions released with MuSiQue, reaches only $0.639$ AUROC on SQuAD~2.0, and needs several thousand clinical training examples before it outperforms a feature-based estimator. Used as a gate for a 7B reader, it reduces the error rate on answered questions from $0.850$ to $0.631$ at $5\%$ coverage, outperforming both reader confidence and, on average, the ground-truth integrity label, although a 7B LLM judge is the better gate at $10\%$ coverage. These results indicate that the way insufficient evidence is constructed matters as much as the estimator that detects it.
articles.titleCn: 在回答之前：尺寸匹配记忆构建中的证据充分性
articles.abstractCn: 能够从压缩或检索到的记忆中回答问题的代理必须识别出查询所需证据已不在记忆中的情况。针对这项任务的基准测试通常通过删除支持性段落来创建不足证据示例。我们证明这种构造通过记忆大小泄露了标签：在MuSiQue数据集上，一个仅统计段落的分类器在检测不安全记忆方面的ROC曲线下面积（AUROC）达到0.979，高于我们最初评估的词汇估计器。我们提出了一种大小匹配的构造方法，可证明地消除了这种捷径，并使用它来研究MemSafe，这是一种将查询与每个记忆单元交叉编码并使用集合转换器聚合单元的估计器。在三个多跳问答数据集和五个种子上，MemSafe在MuSiQue和HotpotQA上达到0.968和0.983的AUROC，比词汇基线高出0.26至0.39，而第三个数据集2WikiMultiHopQA已饱和。一个带有逻辑头的冻结预训练交叉编码器已经缩小了MuSiQue中词汇基线和MemSafe之间的差距的41%。同时，MemSafe在不回答的问题上表现劣于一个弱基线，在SQuAD~2.0上仅达到0.639的AUROC，并且需要数千个临床训练示例才能优于基于特征的估计器。作为7B阅读器的门控使用时，它在5%覆盖率下将回答问题的错误率从0.850降至0.631，优于阅读器置信度，并且在平均情况下优于真实完整性标签，尽管在10%覆盖率下，7B大型语言模型裁判是更好的门控。这些结果表明，不足证据的构造方式与检测它的估计器一样重要。

articles.title: LANTERN: Illuminating Hidden Mathematical Knowledge in Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models can now prove theorems, but people still decide which problems to pursue. We ask whether a model's internal representations can help identify promising mathematical connections. We develop LANTERN, a fast, cost-efficient pipeline that uses a classifier over pretrained-model activations to rank candidate relations, followed by staged filtering, hypothesis generation, executable verification, and analytical checking. Applied to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), LANTERN ranked 50 million pairs among 10,000 frequently referenced sequences and produced 62 verified relations between pairs without an existing OEIS cross-reference. A content screen retained 13 relations worth presenting; nine of these are informative or insightful, including four which are entirely novel to the best of our knowledge: none appears in the OEIS or in our targeted literature search. The entire end-to-end process including classifier training, candidate ranking, filtering and verification took under 8 hours.
articles.titleCn: 灯笼：照亮语言模型中隐藏的数学知识
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型现在可以证明定理，但人们仍然决定要追求哪些问题。我们探究模型的内部表征是否能够帮助识别有潜力的数学联系。我们开发了LANTERN，一个快速、成本效益高的流程，该流程使用预训练模型的激活分类器对候选关系进行排序，然后进行分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证和分析检查。将其应用于整数序列在线百科全书（OEIS），LANTERN在10,000个频繁引用的序列中排序了5000万对，并生成了62对已验证的关系，而这些关系在OEIS中没有现有的交叉引用。内容筛选保留了13对值得展示的关系；其中9对具有信息量或启发性，包括4对据我们所知完全是全新的：它们既未出现在OEIS中，也未出现在我们的目标文献检索中。整个端到端流程，包括分类器训练、候选排序、过滤和验证，耗时不到8小时。

articles.title: Clarify the User or Verify the World? Uncertainty Routing for Proactive Agents
articles.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents must decide not only whether additional information is needed, but also which source can resolve the uncertainty. Existing proactive approaches often specialize in either user clarification or environment verification, without explicitly determining the appropriate information source for each decision. We formulate this problem as uncertainty routing among ACT, CLARIFY, and VERIFY, and propose PROUR, a proactive uncertainty routing framework. PROUR decomposes action uncertainty into disagreement across plausible user-goal interpretations, which signals user-side ambiguity, and the entropy remaining within each interpretation, which signals missing world-side evidence. To acquire information from the routed source, a query generator is trained with a mode-conditioned information-gain reward, targeting user-goal identification under CLARIFY and next-action identification under VERIFY. On $τ$-bench, PROUR achieves 28.17% average success rate across retail and airline, outperforming the strongest prior method by 4.57% while using 2.17 fewer interaction steps. The learned policy further generalizes to stronger task agents and transactional domains of $τ^3$-bench without retraining, demonstrating the benefit of source-aligned uncertainty resolution for proactive agents.
articles.titleCn: 澄清用户还是验证世界？主动代理的不确定性路由
articles.abstractCn: 使用工具的LLM代理不仅需要决定是否需要额外信息，还需要确定哪个信息源可以解决不确定性。现有的主动方法通常专注于用户澄清或环境验证，而没有明确地为每个决策确定适当的信息源。我们将这个问题表述为在ACT、CLARIFY和VERIFY之间的不确定性路由，并提出了PROUR，一个主动不确定性路由框架。PROUR将行动不确定性分解为跨可能的用户目标解释的分歧，这表明用户端的模糊性，以及每个解释中剩余的熵，这表明世界端缺失的证据。为了从路由源获取信息，查询生成器使用模式条件的信息增益奖励进行训练，目标是在CLARIFY下识别用户目标，在VERIFY下识别下一步行动。在$τ$-bench上，PROUR在零售和航空领域实现了28.17%的平均成功率，比最强的先前方法提高了4.57%，同时减少了2.17个交互步骤。学习到的策略进一步泛化到更强的任务代理和$τ^3$-bench的交易领域，而无需重新训练，这证明了源对齐的不确定性解决对主动代理的好处。

articles.title: Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can solve every intermediate step of a multi-step math problem on its own and still fail the full problem, even when given a roadmap of the steps and all of their answers. We introduce OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that locates where LLM math reasoning fails by giving the model increasing levels of oracle help. For each problem, a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing the model with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus the milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. On 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap. It covers 33-48% of problems, and 24-37% after removing problems that an LLM review flags as grading errors. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder carries over to code generation. We release the data, roadmaps, prompts, and code at https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 47 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder
articles.titleCn: 解决每一步都不够：里程碑预言揭示了大型语言模型数学推理中的组合差距
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够独立解决多步数学问题的每一个中间步骤，但即便在提供步骤路线图和所有答案的情况下，仍然可能无法解决整个问题。我们引入了OracleLadder，这是一种诊断性评估方法，通过给予模型逐步增加的“神谕”帮助来定位LLM数学推理失败之处。对于每个问题，教师模型会编写一个固定的中间子目标（里程碑）路线图，并由确定性符号验证器对每个答案进行评分。通过测试模型在无帮助、仅提供路线图、提供路线图加里程碑答案以及单独测试每个里程碑的情况下的表现，将每次失败归类为五种推理差距之一。在354个NuminaMath问题和六个参数规模从8B到671B的模型（Qwen3、gpt-oss、Llama 3.3、DeepSeek-V3.1）上测试，每个模型的最大差距是组合差距，这是一种更严格的形式的组合性差距，涵盖了33-48%的问题，在排除LLM评审标记为评分错误的问题后，该差距占比为24-37%。准确率和里程碑帮助恢复情况对两个最强模型的排序不同，而两个RLVR运行在相似准确率提升下对问题的排序也不同。路线图效应在MATH500和AIME 2024/25上得到验证，单问题恢复情况在独立第二教师下对83-87%的问题达成一致，帮助阶梯效应也适用于代码生成。我们已将数据、路线图、提示和代码发布在https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder。

articles.title: KinyaMed: Seeds, Not Rows -- What a Corpus Requirement Written in the Wrong Unit Fails to Constrain
articles.abstract: Triage decides who is seen first. Building an urgency classifier for patient-voice Kinyarwanda, we found our specification could be met without producing anything it was meant to secure. We report that, and the instruments that detect it, instead of a classifier. Designed for the four languages a Rwandan health centre receives, with every instrument per-language: sentences are authored in all four arms and rows generate in one, because the frame slots those three need do not exist. Our requirement asked for one million examples; generation produced them in 130 seconds. It fails four of the nine quality gates in that specification, six when rows are attributed to their source sentence. The binding gate counts distinct authored seed phrases, not rows: at our 165, no corpus passes at any row count. Two shortfalls follow and differ: 2,835 further sentences to pass the seed-count gate, 19,835 to reach the stated million rows, because a separate gate caps a seed at 50 rows. Rows come from a machine at 7,700 per second; seeds from clinicians. A row count constrains the cheap quantity, leaves the expensive one free, and so does not constrain quality at all. Two further negatives follow. An evaluation set of 17,942 rows built from nine distinct sentences supports no verdict: our gate, which counts distinct sentences, refuses 38 of its cells and reports nothing. A model trained on a corpus of uniform surface form changes its predicted urgency for 31.5% of inputs under capitalisation and 21.0% under a single typo, reported as measurement and not attribution. A model directory shipped without its tokenizer loads without error and answers its class prior on input it cannot read, with well-formed probabilities. No figure here is evidence of model quality; the contribution is the apparatus and the negative results it produced, reproducible from a clean clone except where marked NOT REPRODUCIBLE.
articles.comment: 34 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Negative-results and methodology paper; no model performance claims are made
articles.titleCn: KinyaMed：种子而非行——以错误单位书写的语料库需求未能约束的内容
articles.abstractCn: 分诊决定优先处理顺序。为患者用基尼亚鲁瓦达语构建紧急程度分类器时，我们发现即使未生成预期保障的内容，也能满足我们的规范要求。我们报告了这一点，以及用于检测它的工具，而不是分类器。该设计针对卢旺达卫生中心接收的四种语言，每种语言配备一个工具：所有四种语言的手臂和行生成，因为框架槽位中缺少那三个所需的槽位。我们的需求要求一百万个示例；生成过程在130秒内完成了它们。它在规范要求的九个质量门中失败四个，当行被归因于其源句时，会失败六个。绑定门统计不同的创作种子短语，而不是行：在我们165的情况下，没有语料库在任何行数下通过。两个不足之处随之而来且不同：需要额外2,835个句子才能通过种子计数门，需要19,835个句子才能达到所述的一百万行，因为一个单独的门将种子限制在50行。行来自机器，每秒7,700行；种子来自临床医生。行计数限制了廉价数量，而昂贵数量保持自由，因此根本不限制质量。另外两个负面结果随之而来。一个由九个不同句子构建的17,942行评估集不支持任何结论：我们的门，统计不同的句子，拒绝38个单元格并报告了什么。在统一表面形式的语料库上训练的模型，在大小写情况下改变了31.5%输入的预测紧急程度，在单个拼写错误情况下改变了21.0%，报告为测量而非归因。一个没有其分词器的模型目录加载时没有错误，并对其无法读取的输入回答其类别先验，并给出良好形成的概率。这里没有图表证明模型质量；贡献是工具和它产生的负面结果，除了标记为“不可重复”的部分外，可以从干净的克隆中重复。

articles.title: OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?
articles.abstract: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out/stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures, with LLM API cost reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock. The empirical study asks three questions: whether models can close the calibrated gap between a designated weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they can refine editable competent baselines without damaging them, and whether gains survive surface obfuscation controls. Across twelve frontier LLMs and five games, models improve designated weak starters more consistently than they refine editable competent baselines, with substantial variation across games and models. OptiArena provides a practical testbed for measuring bounded-resource algorithm optimization within the five-edit, fixed-scaffold setting studied here. Code is available at https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena.
articles.titleCn: OptiArena：在固定资源预算下，大型语言模型能否改进可执行算法？
articles.abstractCn: 静态质量保证和代码生成基准测试只能部分捕捉大型语言模型（LLM）现在作为编码代理和研究工具所扮演的角色。我们介绍了OptiArena，一个预算控制的测试平台，用于研究LLM是否能在固定的最小框架和有限的评估器反馈以及固定的资源预算下，通过五轮代码编辑来改进可执行的游戏算法。该测试平台采用两种优化机制、表面混淆控制、校准参考、保留/压力分割，以及用于退化检测和异常失败的诊断，并将LLM API成本单独报告，与本地评估器时钟成本分开。实证研究提出了三个问题：模型是否能够缩小指定弱启动器与可编辑的合格基线之间的校准差距，是否能够在不损害它们的情况下改进可编辑的合格基线，以及收益是否能在表面混淆控制下持续存在。在十二个前沿LLM和五种游戏中，模型改进指定弱启动器的效果比改进可编辑的合格基线更一致，但在不同游戏和模型之间存在显著差异。OptiArena为在五轮编辑、固定框架设置下测量有限资源算法优化提供了一个实用测试平台。代码可在https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena获取。

articles.title: A model of rational interlocutors: Unification of comprehension and production
articles.abstract: Who we communicate with influences both our interpretation of their utterances and the design of our own. Such adjustment to the conversational partner is studied as speaker modeling in comprehension and as audience design in production, with the two literatures having developed largely separately. We argue that both adjustments express one rational computation and propose the rational interlocutor (RI) model, a computational account unifying comprehension and production. An interlocutor maintains a model of their partner, defined by three parameters: an identity parameter Π sets the messages and forms expected from the partner; a fidelity parameter Φ sets how reliably messages and utterances map onto each other for them; a knowledge parameter Λ sets how knowledgeable the partner is believed to be. Comprehension and production are thus mirror-image modes of one computation over the partner model. Comprehension chooses the message the partner most likely intends to convey, weighing how well each candidate fits the utterance against how likely this partner is to mean it. Production chooses the utterance from which the partner will best recover the message, weighed against the effort of saying it. This explains why comprehenders appear to rely less on the forms produced by a linguistically less competent speaker, while producers tend to invest more effort in designing forms for them. We conjecture that perceived linguistic competence decomposes into two of these quantities: fidelity and knowledge. Their contrasting profiles across second-language (L2) adults, children, and artificial partners produce distinct and testable predictions.
articles.comment: A computational model of partner modeling in language comprehension and production. 62 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, including supplementary materials
articles.titleCn: 一个理性对话者的模型：理解与生产的统一
articles.abstractCn: 我们与谁交流，会影响我们对他们话语的理解以及我们自身话语的设计。这种对对话伙伴的调整，在理解过程中被研究为说话人建模，在生产过程中被研究为受众设计，这两个文献领域在很大程度上是独立发展的。我们认为这两种调整都表达了一种理性计算，并提出了理性对话者（RI）模型，这是一个将理解和生产统一起来的计算模型。对话者维护一个关于其伙伴的模型，该模型由三个参数定义：身份参数Π设定了从伙伴那里期望接收的信息和形式；保真度参数Φ设定了信息与话语对他们而言如何可靠地映射；知识参数Λ设定了伙伴被认为有多了解。因此，理解和生产是伙伴模型上的一种计算模式的镜像。理解选择伙伴最可能想要传达的信息，权衡每个候选信息与话语的匹配程度以及伙伴说出它的可能性。生产选择伙伴能够最好地恢复信息的话语，权衡说出它的努力程度。这解释了为什么理解者似乎较少依赖语言能力较弱的说话者产生的形式，而生产者倾向于为它们投入更多精力设计形式。我们推测感知的语言能力分解为这两个量：保真度和知识。它们在第二语言（L2）成人、儿童和人工伙伴中的不同特征产生了独特且可检验的预测。

articles.title: HM-ROUTER: Joint Model and Harness Routing for Agentic Systems
articles.abstract: Agent performance depends on both the underlying model and the harness that manages its tool use and execution. Selecting a suitable pair requires accounting for their compatibility, yet training samples may cover only a subset of the growing combination space. We introduce HM-Router, a routing method that jointly selects a model and harness for each query. It learns separate model and harness representations shared across routes, with an interaction term inspired by canonical polyadic (CP) tensor decomposition to capture how their compatibility varies with the query. This sharing allows training samples from observed pairs to inform predictions for unobserved combinations. We curate a benchmark from 12 public agent benchmarks, covering 293 routes, 73 models, and 25 harnesses. HM-Router exceeds the strongest evaluated learned baseline by 7.3 percentage points in mean routing accuracy and leads at all seven evaluated cost budgets on the six-benchmark subset. When 90% of routes have their training outcomes withheld, allowing unobserved combinations improves normalized accuracy by 15.8 points over restricting the same router to observed routes. HM-Router has also demonstrated training sample efficiency for new routes and components and generalization to unseen benchmarks. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/hmarkc/HM-Router.
articles.titleCn: HM-ROUTER：用于智能体系统的联合模型和线束路由
articles.abstractCn: 代理的性能取决于底层模型和管理其工具使用与执行的框架。选择合适的组合需要考虑其兼容性，但训练样本可能仅覆盖不断增长组合空间的一个子集。我们引入HM-Router，这是一种联合为每个查询选择模型和框架的路由方法。它学习在不同路由间共享的独立模型和框架表示，并采用受规范多项式（CP）张量分解启发的交互项来捕捉其兼容性如何随查询变化。这种共享允许从观察到的组合对中训练样本为未观察到的组合提供预测。我们从12个公开代理基准中整理出一个基准，涵盖293条路由、73个模型和25个框架。HM-Router在平均路由准确率上比最强的评估学习基线高出7.3个百分点，并在六个基准子集的七个评估成本预算中均表现最佳。当90%的路由的训练结果被隐藏时，允许未观察到的组合比将同一路由器限制在观察到的路由上使标准化准确率提高了15.8个百分点。HM-Router还展示了对新路由和组件的训练样本效率以及泛化到未见基准的能力。我们的代码和数据已开源，位于https://github.com/hmarkc/HM-Router。

articles.title: Generalization and Memorization along the Learning Trajectory of Neural Language Models: A Geometric Account of Categorization
articles.abstract: We investigate how generalization and memorization develop along the learning trajectory of neural language models. Using controlled synthetic grammars, we examine both the geometry of representation space and model behaviour over training. We find that continuous regions of representation space not occupied by observed tokens become systematically structured from the earliest stages of learning, forming category-level geometric organization that supports generalization to unattested combinations. Generalization therefore emerges from the beginning of learning rather than only after extensive memorization. With prolonged training, larger models increasingly distinguish observed from unobserved grammatical combinations. At the same time, the continuous geometric structure supporting category-level generalization is gradually destructed. Together, these results suggest that neural language models initially learn through categorization-based generalization, followed by a gradual transition toward more exemplar-specific memorization.

articles.titleCn: 神经网络语言模型学习轨迹中的泛化与记忆：分类的几何解释
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了神经语言模型在学习轨迹中泛化和记忆的发展过程。通过使用受控的合成语法，我们考察了表征空间的几何结构以及模型在训练过程中的行为。我们发现，表征空间中未被观察到的标记占据的连续区域从学习的最早阶段开始就系统地形成结构，形成了支持对未观察到的组合进行泛化的类别级几何组织。因此，泛化在学习开始时就出现了，而不仅仅是在大量记忆之后才出现。随着训练的持续，更大的模型越来越多地区分观察到的和未观察到的语法组合。与此同时，支持类别级泛化的连续几何结构逐渐被破坏。这些结果共同表明，神经语言模型最初通过基于类别的泛化进行学习，然后逐渐过渡到更具体的实例记忆。

articles.title: The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing
articles.abstract: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models. If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.
articles.titleCn: 法官并非其孪生：训练后的模型使其写作更具可预测性，但几乎未改变其作为法官，对可预测性写作的偏好。
articles.abstractCn: 现在语言模型正被其他语言模型常规地评分。如果训练后使模型自己的写作更可预测，它也可能教会同一个模型，充当裁判，奖励可预测的写作，从而让创造力上的进步对自动化评估来说变得不可见。我们追踪了两个开源模型家族——OLMo-2和Zephyr（每个模型参数量为7B）——的公开训练阶段，并在每个阶段进行两次测量，分别作为短篇小说作者和故事对裁判。作为作者，模型如预期般发生了变化：每个家族的完全训练模型发现其基础、监督微调（SFT）和偏好训练（DPO）阶段的故事在所有十个提示下变得越来越熟悉，而来自另一家族的模型发现训练后的故事每个token的意外程度降低了7.0%至9.2%（OLMo-2）和24%至25%（Zephyr）。作为裁判，它们几乎未向可预测的写作方向移动。当被问及哪个故事更好时——这是一个每个裁判都可以用来从自己的混乱文字中区分故事的提问——没有训练后的裁判对更可预测故事的倾向估计在挑选它的概率上增加了超过一个点。对此增长的事后单边95%上限平均为2.7点，大约等于未训练的OLMo-2裁判自身的倾向大小。当被问及哪个更具创造力时，没有训练后的裁判的估计没有比其基础模型更倾向于可预测的故事。当问及创造力时，训练反而加强了对于更长故事和单个答案槽的偏好，并破坏了“更创造力”作为一个问题的有效性：训练后的裁判不再可靠地倾向于一个故事相对于其混乱文字。后续研究无法构建在可预测性上不同但在质量上没有差异的故事对，因为使这位作者的故事变得不那么可预测的路径也破坏了其中的一些故事，频繁到足以未能达到预先设定的质量底线。

articles.title: ScopeIF: Improving Scope-Aware Precise Instruction-Following in Large Language Models via Graded Reward Modeling
articles.abstract: Precise instruction-following is a fundamental ability of large language models (LLMs), requiring their outputs to strictly satisfy objective constraints in input instructions. In complex application scenarios, these constraints often possess diverse scopes that govern specific response segments rather than the entire output. However, existing optimization methods often neglect constraint scope during data construction and rely on binary per-constraint rewards, yielding limited data diversity and sparse supervision for complex constraints. To this end, we propose ScopeIF, a novel training framework for scope-aware precise instruction-following. We first introduce a unified schema that factorizes objective constraints into three decoupled dimensions: Scope, Target, and Range. Grounded in this schema, we construct ScopeInstruct, a large-scale instruction dataset with diverse scope-aware constraints, and combine tool-grounded verification with graded reward modeling to quantify the violation degree of each constraint, providing dense supervision for policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScopeIF consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex scope-aware constraints, while preserving general capabilities. Notably, it enables optimized Qwen3-4B and 8B models to rival or surpass strong frontier models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, establishing an effective paradigm for advancing scope-aware instruction-following. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF.
articles.titleCn: ScopeIF：通过分级奖励建模提升大型语言模型中的范围感知精确指令遵循能力
articles.abstractCn: 精确指令遵循是大语言模型（LLMs）的一项基本能力，要求其输出严格满足输入指令中的目标约束。在复杂应用场景中，这些约束通常具有多样化的范围，这些范围控制着特定响应段而不是整个输出。然而，现有的优化方法在数据构建时往往忽略约束范围，并依赖针对每个约束的二进制奖励，导致数据多样性有限且复杂约束的监督稀疏。为此，我们提出了ScopeIF，一个用于范围感知精确指令遵循的新型训练框架。我们首先引入一个统一架构，将目标约束分解为三个解耦维度：范围（Scope）、目标（Target）和范围（Range）。基于此架构，我们构建了ScopeInstruct，一个具有多样化范围感知约束的大规模指令数据集，并结合工具验证与分级奖励建模，量化每个约束的违反程度，为策略优化提供密集监督。大量实验表明，ScopeIF始终优于现有方法，尤其是在复杂的范围感知约束上，同时保留了泛化能力。值得注意的是，它使优化的Qwen3-4B和8B模型能够媲美甚至超越Gemini-2.5-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2等强前沿模型，为推进范围感知指令遵循建立了一种有效范式。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF获取。

articles.title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
articles.abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 8 tables. Corpus: 28 arXiv papers (19-24 September 2026); arXiv versions listed in Appendix A. Ancillary file: per-paper corpus sheet (versions and headline results)
articles.titleCn: 类型化决策模型：早期证据审计与评估清单
articles.abstractCn: 类型化决策模型（TDMs）在不生成文本的情况下返回调用者定义选项的概率分布。TypeSafe于2026年9月15日发布了一款商业化的类型化决策模型Jev，几天内就出现了少量评估和复现工作。我们回顾了9月19日至24日期间发布的28篇论文，并将它们的发现与早期关于标签-概率分类、约束解码、重新排序、校准和模型级联的研究联系起来。在这篇早期文献中，类型化输出本身并未显示出比同等标签-概率输出更高的独立准确度优势。Jev最明显的优势在于延迟和成本，而在更困难的任务上准确度差距仍然存在。在实际部署中，置信度通常用于决定何时委派给更强的模型或人类。我们利用这些研究中的反复出现的弱点，为未来的TDM工作推导出一个包含14项的评估清单。由于证据仅涵盖一个托管模型发布后的头九天，因此这篇综述应被视为早期证据地图，而不是对模型类别的最终评估。

articles.title: Checking Leakage Witnesses versus Certifying Bounded Non-Leakage
articles.abstract: When a language-model audit finds no leak, what is needed to certify non-leakage? We study guarantees over a declared prompt domain under an executable leakage criterion and decoding rule. For general bounded polynomial-time evaluators, a supplied leaking execution is polynomial-time checkable, while leak existence is \NP-complete and deterministic certification is \coNP-complete. Exact stochastic certification is $\coNP^{\PP}$-complete at every fixed rational cutoff in $(0,1)$. Restricting the computation can change these bounds. For example, certification is in \coNP\ when all randomness is a terminal draw from an efficiently computed finite probability table. Attention models admit polynomial-time certification when local dependency windows of logarithmic length precede one global head, given deterministic decoding, fixed vocabulary, exact rational weighted means, a direct binary affine readout and finite-automaton prompt domains. A construction with two global layers instead makes certification \coNP-complete over template domains, with one head per layer, polynomial width, logarithmic precision and an inverse-polynomial logit margin. Planted-secret experiments measure what finite audits miss relative to complete references. Among 30 secret--model-state pairs that leak under greedy single-prompt execution on their secret's 4,096-prompt domain, uniformly selecting 256 recorded evaluations per pair misses every leak for an expected $41.06\%$ of these pairs. Batched and single-prompt checks disagree on one complete-domain decision among all 48 fine-tuned pairs, while a same-order repeat reproduces every single-prompt output. These results distinguish computational conditions for certification from the coverage and execution conditions needed to interpret a negative audit.
articles.titleCn: 检查泄漏见证与认证有界非泄漏
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型审计未发现泄露时，如何认证非泄露性？我们研究了在可执行泄露标准和解码规则下，针对声明提示域的保证。对于一般的有界多项式时间评估器，提供的泄露执行是多项式时间可验证的，而泄露存在问题是\NP完全问题，确定性认证是\coNP完全问题。在\((0,1)\)中每个固定的有理截止点，精确的随机认证是$\coNP^{\PP}$完全问题。限制计算可以改变这些界限。例如，当所有随机性都来自一个高效计算的有穷概率表的单次抽取时，认证属于\coNP。在确定性解码、固定词汇、精确有理加权均值、直接二进制仿射读取和有限自动机提示域的条件下，注意力模型在局部依赖窗口长度为对数时，允许多项式时间认证。使用两个全局层构造，则认证在模板域上是\coNP完全问题，每层一个头，多项式宽度，对数精度和逆多项式logit裕度。植入密钥实验测量了有限审计相对于完整参考所遗漏的内容。在30对在密钥的4,096提示域上通过贪婪单提示执行而泄露的密钥-模型状态对中，均匀选择每对256次记录的评估，对于这些对的预期41.06%遗漏了所有泄露。批量检查和单提示检查在所有48对微调对中，在完整域决策上存在分歧，而相同顺序的重复可以重现每个单提示输出。这些结果区分了认证所需的计算条件与解释负面审计所需的覆盖和执行条件。

articles.title: Using LMs to Model the Effects of Context and Coreference during Sentence Comprehension
articles.abstract: Language models (LMs) are often used as a tool to model human language processing. Recent studies suggest that severely restricting LMs' context window improves their fit to human psycholinguistic data by simulating human working memory constraints. However, it is possible that this strict memory-decay approach overlooks humans' reliance on long-range structural representations, such as discourse structre. In this work, we systematically vary the context window size of GPT-2 across four large-scale naturalistic English reading-time datasets and observe a U-shaped relationship: Although restricted contexts (< 20 tokens) successfully capture local memory limitations, expanded contexts (500--1,000 tokens) ultimately yield the highest overall psycholinguistic fit. To investigate the mechanism driving this benefit, we conduct a counterfactual inference-time experiment that disrupts cross-sentential entity chains by pronominalizing repeated discourse entities. Obscuring these structural linkages significantly degrades the predictive power of larger context windows by 20% to 40%. Our experiments demonstrate that tracking long-range coreference relations is one important factor for the alignment between LM surprisal and human reading behavior, and approximate the extent to which human comprehenders use global discourse relations during language processing.
articles.titleCn: 使用语言模型模拟句子理解过程中上下文和指代的效果
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LMs）通常被用作模拟人类语言处理过程的工具。近期研究表明，严格限制LMs的上下文窗口可以通过模拟人类工作记忆约束来提高其与人类心理语言数据的拟合度。然而，这种严格的记忆衰减方法可能忽略了人类对长程结构表征（如话语结构）的依赖。在这项工作中，我们系统地改变GPT-2的上下文窗口大小，并在四个大规模自然英语阅读时间数据集上进行观察，发现呈现U形关系：虽然受限的上下文（<20个词元）成功地捕捉了局部记忆限制，但扩展的上下文（500-1000个词元）最终产生了最高的整体心理语言拟合度。为了探究驱动这种效益的机制，我们进行了一项反事实推理时间实验，通过代词化重复的话语实体来破坏跨句实体链。遮蔽这些结构联系显著降低了较大上下文窗口的预测能力，降低了20%至40%。我们的实验表明，追踪长程共指关系是LM意外度和人类阅读行为之间对齐的一个重要因素，并近似地反映了人类理解者在语言处理过程中使用全局话语关系的程度。
